Abstract: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) patients require early, accurate detection to enable timely treatment and effective patient management. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is well-suited for creating an end-to-end enabling environment for ALL detection and classification. However, most CNN-based ALL detection systems are theoretical and unsuitable for deployment on edge devices due to high computational demands. The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT)-enabled devices offer an opportunity to monitor ALL patients in real time. Wearables that track temperature, heart rate, oxygen saturation, and activity can deliver critical data to support timely clinical intervention and improve patient outcomes. In smart IoMT environments, a lightweight CNN is essential because connected devices often operate under limited computational power, memory, and latency constraints. To address this need, this study proposes LukeNet, a lightweight CNN integrated with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) for an IoMT-based SMART Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Detection and Management System. Trained on three (3) ALL datasets and five-fold cross-validation, LukeNet achieved an impressive 99% model accuracy as well as 99% unseen test accuracy, which is higher than six state-of-the-art (SOTA) CNNs, such as DenseNet121, MobileNet, ResNet50, InceptionV3, Xception, and VGG16, as well as transfer learning models. Furthermore, LukeNet was compared with two ensemble models. In addition, explainable AI methods are integrated to highlight relevant regions in microscopic images. The novelty of this study lies in the architecture of LukeNet, which balances model depth and computational efficiency by using depthwise separable convolutions, mitigates the risk of gradient loss in deeper layers, and provides strong global and local feature extraction capabilities.

</details>


### [48] [Seeing the Heat: Synthesizing High-Resolution Wood Thermal Responses from Optical Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31737)
*Jingren Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出端到端计算框架，从木材RGB图像合成高分辨率热响应：建立光学强度→局部固体体积分数的物理联系，用自动有限元数据引擎生成合成热响应，并以此监督基于DINOv3的神经代理模型，实现像素级热推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 木材热行为对先进材料组装至关重要，但红外热成像分辨率低、噪声大，像素级热分析 fundamentally 受限，缺乏高分辨率热响应数据。

Method: 建立物理联系：天然木材颜色空间变化源于细胞解剖结构，故光学强度可作为局部固体体积分数的几何代理。据此开发自动有限元（FEM）数据引擎，将像素级光学强度映射为3D热力学体素网格，生成高保真合成热响应；再用合成热响应监督基于DINOv3基础模型的神经代理模型。

Result: 1) 当厚度方向热导率均匀或线性时，RGB图像与热响应呈极端形态相似性，横向热扩散如低通滤波器平滑高频细节；2) 当厚度方向热导率为随机时，形态相似性被破坏，木材3D结构主导热响应。神经代理模型成功内化热力学定律，绕过昂贵的计算仿真，实现高分辨率热推断。

Conclusion: 该框架有效桥接语义域与热力学域，实现细粒度木材热响应的系统性像素级分析。

Abstract: The thermal behavior of wood is a critical factor in advanced material assembly. However, pixel-level thermal analysis remains fundamentally constrained by the low resolution and noise inherent to infrared thermography. To address this, we introduce an end-to-end computational framework that synthesizes high-resolution thermal responses directly from wood RGB images. We first establish a core physical linkage: because spatial color variation in natural wood is driven by cellular anatomy, optical intensity serves as a reliable geometric proxy for the localized solid volume fraction. By leveraging this theoretical insight, we develop an automated finite-element-method data engine that maps pixel-level optical intensity to a 3D thermodynamic voxel grid, generating high-fidelity synthetic thermal responses. We find that 1) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is uniform or linear, wood RGB images and their corresponding thermal responses exhibit extreme morphological similarities, and the lateral thermal diffusion acts as a low-pass filter that smooths out high-frequency details; 2) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is random, such morphological similarities are destroyed, and wood's 3D structure dominantly governs its thermal response. We further utilize these synthetic thermal responses to supervise a neural surrogate model built upon the DINOv3 foundation model. Our results demonstrate that the neural surrogate model successfully internalizes the governing thermodynamic laws, thereby bypassing computationally expensive simulations and enabling high-resolution thermal inference. This methodology effectively bridges the semantic and thermodynamic domains, unlocking systematic, pixel-level analysis of fine-grained wood thermal responses. Project: https://zekifayes.github.io/seeheat

</details>


### [49] [Beyond Volume Overlap: Surface Matching for Topology-Aware Coronary Artery Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31740)
*Rafael Velasquez,Esther Puyol-Antón,Pablo Arbeláez*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文指出现有基于Dice的CCTA冠状动脉分割评价忽略纤细分支，提出一种基于二分图分配的表面度量及可微表面损失，可区分假阳（虚假分支）与假阴（漏检分支），并在多个骨干与数据集上验证其能恢复远端血管、提升表面F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冠状动脉在CCTA上呈细管状结构，而深度网络通常以Dice等体积重叠度量进行训练与评估。由于多数体素属于少数粗大的近端血管段，漏掉远端分支对Dice影响甚微，却严重破坏临床所需的血管连通性。且对称的Dice无法区分虚假分支（假阳）与漏检分支（假阴），掩盖了模型的真实缺陷，因此需要面向血管表面的度量与优化目标。

Method: 1) 提出表面度量：在局部化的、与血管半径相关的容差范围内，通过二分图分配匹配预测表面点与参考表面点，输出precision、recall与F1，并分别解耦假阳（spurious branches）与假阴（missed branches）。2) 基于该度量提出可微表面损失，同时抑制多余质量（spurious mass）并恢复缺失结构。3) 在Image-CAS与ASOCA两个公开基准上，对nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU三种骨干进行微调验证，并与同等训练轮数的对照实验比较。

Result: 借助所提表面度量发现，一个强Dice训练的基线其漏检的血管表面远多于其生成的虚假结构，这种不对称性被其高Dice分数所掩盖。与匹配轮数的对照相比，所提可微表面损失在Dice相当的情况下显著提升表面F1，主要得益于恢复漏检的远端血管。

Conclusion: 结果表明，对于冠状动脉这类细管状解剖结构，应度量并优化血管表面而非其所重叠的体积；将评估与优化目标从体积重叠转向血管表面，可更好反映临床所需的连通性，并有效改善远端血管的完整性。

Abstract: Accurate coronary artery segmentation on coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) is essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease. Deep networks are conventionally trained and evaluated with the Dice coefficient, but volume-overlap metrics are poorly suited to thin, tubular anatomy: since most voxels belong to a few thickproximal segments, a missing distal branch barely affects Dice despite severely disrupting the connectivity required for clinical use. We introduce a surface metric that matches predicted and reference surface points via bipartite assignment under a localized, vessel-radius tolerance, reporting precision, recall, and F1 with decoupled false positives (spurious branches) and false negatives (missed branches) a distinction the symmetric Dice cannot make. With it we show that a strong Dice-trained baseline omits far more vessel surface than it hallucinates, an asymmetry its high Dice hides. Building on this, we propose a differentiable surface loss that simultaneously suppresses spurious mass and recovers absent structure, validated by fine-tuning three backbones (nnU-Net, SwinUNETR, NexToU) on two public benchmarks (Image-CAS, ASOCA). Against a matched-epoch control, it significantly improves surface F1 by recovering missed distal vessels at comparable Dice. Our findings argue for measuring and optimizing the vessel surface, not the volume it overlaps. Code

</details>


### [50] [PEEL-DDPM: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31742)
*Ge Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PEEL-DDPM，用物理学启发的证据学习框架解决NIG回归在Student-t边际似然下不可辨识的问题，通过在DDPM重建中建模可辨识坐标并利用嵌套蒙特卡洛估计方差，实现扩散图像重建的可辨识、可物理解释的不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Normal-inverse-gamma回归从其边际Student-t似然不可辨识：四个NIG参数仅三种组合被确定，留有自由度。扩散模型重建中的不确定性量化需要可辨识且物理可解释的方法。

Method: 先以epsilon-MSE训练测量条件DDPM并冻结；其完整逆轨迹生成重建，与已知训练对象的残差由终图证据网络建模。网络仅学习可辨识的Student-t坐标，重复扫描噪声实现与重复扩散轨迹提供终图偶然方差的嵌套蒙特卡洛估计，分为扫描仪诱导与采样器诱导分量，以此测量方差解决NIG歧义，将预测不确定性分解为测量、扩散与认知项。采用无跨损失权重系数的顺序训练。

Result: 八个留出对象的可行性研究中，名义50%、80%、90%、95%区间的经验中心区间覆盖率分别为49.3%、80.3%、90.1%、95.6%。均方残差为平均预测方差的0.967倍，单图偶然头对独立嵌套参考的合并Spearman相关为0.785。五个剂量水平下，扫描仪诱导方差的log-log剂量斜率为-1.15，采样器诱导方差近乎剂量无关，斜率-0.01。

Conclusion: 结果支持PEEL-DDPM作为扩散图像重建中可辨识且物理可解释的不确定性量化的实用途径。

Abstract: Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: three combinations of four NIG parameters are determined, leaving one degree of freedom. We introduce PEEL-DDPM, a physics-enabled evidential learning framework for denoising diffusion probabilistic models. A measurement-conditioned DDPM is first trained with epsilon-MSE and then frozen. Its complete reverse trajectory produces a reconstruction, whose residual from the known training object is modeled by a final-image evidential network. The network learns only the identifiable Student-t coordinates, while repeated scanner-noise realizations and repeated diffusion trajectories provide a nested Monte Carlo estimate of final-image aleatoric variance, separated into scanner-induced and sampler-induced components. This measured variance resolves the remaining NIG ambiguity and yields a decomposition of predictive uncertainty into measurement, diffusion, and epistemic terms.
  The method uses sequential training without a cross-loss weighting coefficient. In a feasibility study on eight held-out objects, empirical central-interval coverages were 49.3%, 80.3%, 90.1%, and 95.6% for nominal 50%, 80%, 90%, and 95% intervals. The mean squared residual was 0.967 times the mean predicted variance, and a single-image aleatoric head achieved pooled Spearman correlation 0.785 against an independent nested reference. Across five dose levels, scanner-induced variance showed a log-log dose slope of -1.15, whereas sampler-induced variance remained nearly dose independent with slope -0.01. These results support PEEL-DDPM as a practical route to identifiable and physically interpretable uncertainty quantification in diffusion-based image reconstruction.

</details>


### [51] [VisionPsy-Nano: Improving Accuracy, Efficiency, and Reliability in On-Device Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31746)
*Khurram Azeem Hashmi,Mohammadreza Zolfaghari,Changdae Park,Rishabh Jain,Nicholas Moratelli,Pengfei Wei,Louis Lu,Tianchi Liu,Amril Nazir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出诊断驱动的后训练方法，通过教师VLM压力测试学生模型挖掘失效模式并转化为定向监督与偏好对齐，配合两种视觉token策略，得到NanoFull与FlashFull两个亚十亿参数VLM变体，同时提升精度、效率与行为可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 亚十亿参数VLM可用于端侧部署，但仅靠小模型尺寸不足以保证可用性：手机上首token时延可超过两分钟。端侧可用性取决于精度、效率与行为可靠性三轴，而标准基准忽略第三轴——答案过短无法暴露doom loop，提示过于温和无法探测对抗安全性。

Method: 诊断驱动的后训练配方：由教师VLM对学生模型进行压力测试，发现超出人类先验的失效模式，并将其转化为定向监督数据与偏好对齐，以失效驱动优化补充通用数据扩展；同时结合两种视觉token策略，产出精度-效率的两个变体。

Result: NanoFull在17个基准上取得62.3归一化平均分，为公开释放的约0.5B模型中最高，在同架构同token预算下较基座提升+7.4，doom-loop率不高于最强基线。FlashFull保持61.4，同时将Pixel 9上的热启动首token时延从138秒降至6.1秒（23倍）。

Conclusion: 通过同时优化精度、效率与行为可靠性三轴，推动紧凑型VLM走向实际端侧可用性。

Abstract: Sub-billion-parameter Vision-Language Models are increasingly viable for on-device deployment, yet compact model size alone does not guarantee usability. On a phone, such a model can still require more than two minutes to produce its first token. On-device usability depends on three axes: accuracy, efficiency, and behavioral reliability; standard benchmarks miss the third, with answers too short to expose doom loops and prompts too benign to probe adversarial safety. We introduce a diagnosis-driven post-training recipe in which a teacher VLM stress-tests the student, uncovers failure modes beyond human priors, and converts them into targeted supervision and preference alignment, supplementing generic data scaling with failure-driven optimization. Coupled with two visual-token policies, the recipe yields two accuracy-efficiency variants with improved behavioral reliability. \textbf{\NanoFull} attains a 62.3 normalized average over 17 benchmarks, the highest among openly released $\sim$0.5B models, +7.4 over its base at identical architecture and token budget, with doom-loop rates at or below the strongest baseline's. \textbf{\FlashFull} retains 61.4 while cutting warm time-to-first-token on a Pixel 9 from 138\,s to 6.1\,s (23$\times$). By jointly addressing all three axes, we move compact VLMs toward practical on-device usability.

</details>


### [52] [The Earth in One Gaze: Training-Free Active Focus for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31747)
*Yao Zhang,Pengyu Dai,Wei Guo,Jian Liang,Jian Song,Yafei Ou,Hongruixuan Chen,Naoto Yokoya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GazeEarth：免训练框架，将UHR遥感理解视为"固定像素预算如何分配"问题，用问题引导区域选择+全场景注视式（foveated）重采样，仅需≤2次MLLM调用即显著提升精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM在有限视觉输入预算下解读超高分辨率遥感影像时，需在局部细节与场景上下文间权衡。现有选择式方法分两类：基于相关性打分剪枝token/选patch，或反复裁切主动检视；前者仅保留被选token/patch，后者重编码的裁剪块脱离周边环境。二者均未在连续全场景视图中直接重分配像素。预实验还发现：冻结MLLM已能产生有用的空间请求，但基于裁剪的检视并不能稳定改善答案。

Method: 免训练框架GazeEarth，耦合"问题引导区域选择"与"全场景注视式观测"：MLLM从索引化概览图中选出证据单元（evidence cells）；随后用确定性、保拓扑的形变（topology-preserving warp）将原图重采样至固定尺寸画布，放大所选单元及其共享邻域、压缩外围；由同一冻结模型在此聚焦视图上作答。全程最多2次MLLM调用，无外部选择器、无迭代搜索。

Result: 在3个UHR遥感基准、4个冻结骨干上，GazeEarth较直接作答平均精度提升4.6–9.4个百分点，较概览作答提升3.4–4.3个百分点，并优于任务训练型方法。

Conclusion: 分析表明：现有MLLM能自主引导在UHR图像中"看哪里"；而其从所选证据能推断出什么，取决于该证据如何被呈现。核心贡献在于将UHR理解重构为固定像素预算的分配问题，并以注视式全场景呈现替代裁剪/剪枝范式。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) must balance local detail against scene context when interpreting ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing (RS) imagery within a limited visual-input budget. Existing selection-based methods either prune tokens and select patches through relevance scoring, or crop actively through repeated inspection. Neither strategy directly redistributes pixels within a continuous full-scene view: the first retains selected tokens or patches, and the second re-encodes a crop detached from its surroundings. Our pilot study finds that a frozen MLLM already produces useful question-guided spatial requests, yet crop-based inspection of the selected regions does not consistently improve its answers. We therefore formulate UHR understanding as a question of where to spend a fixed pixel budget. Based on this, we introduce GazeEarth, a simple-yet-effective training-free framework that couples question-guided region selection with full-scene foveated observation. The MLLM selects evidence cells from an indexed overview; a deterministic, topology-preserving warp resamples the original image onto a fixed-size canvas, enlarging their shared neighborhood while compressing the periphery; the same frozen model answers from this focused view, using at most two MLLM calls and no external selector or iterative search. Across three UHR remote sensing benchmarks and four frozen backbones, GazeEarth improves benchmark-averaged accuracy by 4.6 to 9.4 percentage points over direct answering and 3.4 to 4.3 over overview answering, outperforming task-trained methods. Our analyses show that existing MLLMs can guide where to look in UHR images on their own, and that what they can infer from the selected evidence depends on how that evidence is presented.

</details>

*Suraj Singh,Tushar Verma,Pragyan Singh,Shaurya Bhav,Shivam Kumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文对AI生成图像检测的堆叠集成方法进行控制实验复检：融合仅在目标域重拟合时才有增益，单语料评测不足，弃权行为存在相关性且被误处理，语料A存在类别条件JPEG偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作常直接部署堆叠集成并报告优于单模型的结论，但缺乏针对"是否值得融合、评测语料是否充分、弃权/缺失值机制是否合理、数据是否存在捷径偏置"等基本控制实验的检验。作者希望用对照实验检验并纠正自身早期结论。

Method: 构建常规堆叠集成：3个开源检测器产生5个分数，用梯度提升元学习器融合，并将检测器失败视为缺失数据；随后设置三类对照实验：(1)比较出货版（异域拟合）元学习器、域内重拟合堆叠器与最佳单成员/事后校准器；(2)在80张截图小样本上检验AUC置信区间；(3)构造全NaN输入与四检测器静默场景检验弃权行为，并检查语料A的类别条件JPEG偏置。

Result: 出货版元学习器在2000张StyleGAN人脸上不及最佳单成员（AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961，McNemar p=1.000）；域内重拟合堆叠器优于该成员加事后校准器（ΔAUC=+0.0025，CI [+0.0014,+0.0038]，p=3.4e-4）。80张截图下所有模型AUC区间均含0.5，集成与其最佳成员下降之差为[-0.185,+0.115]。五个检测器四个静默且存活者报"真"时，系统输出P(AI)=0.9985，因全NaN输入在未见过缺失的训练器中得分为0.9995；三个AIDE检查点因共享预处理路径同时失效。语料A存在仅凭文件头即可区分类别的JPEG偏置。

Conclusion: 融合的收益依赖目标域重拟合，跨域出货版堆叠器无优势；单语料不足以支撑评测结论；弃权是真实、相关且被误处理的，引入要求两种不同架构的法定人数（quorum）规则可在不重训的前提下避免上述两类失效；语料A的类别条件JPEG偏置限制了所有域内数值的可信度。作者公开代码、测试框架、哈希标识产物及全部更正。

Abstract: We built an ordinary stacking ensemble for AI-generated image detection -- three open detectors producing five scores, fused by a gradient-boosted meta-learner that treats a detector's failure as missing data -- deployed it, and then evaluated it against three controls it should have faced first. This paper reports what the controls found, including where they overturned our own earlier conclusions.
  Fusion is worth its cost only when refitted on the target domain. The shipped meta-learner, fitted on a separate corpus, does not beat its best single member on 2000 StyleGAN faces (AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961; McNemar p = 1.000). But a stacker refitted in-domain beats that member plus a post-hoc calibrator (Delta-AUC = +0.0025, [+0.0014, +0.0038]; p = 3.4e-4). An earlier draft claimed the calibrated single detector won outright; that comparison mixed regimes and we correct it here.
  One corpus is not an evaluation. On 80 screenshots every model's AUC interval contains 0.5. We can say nothing stronger: the difference between the ensemble's drop and its best member's is [-0.185, +0.115].
  Abstention is real, correlated, and mishandled. With four of five detectors silent and the survivor reporting "real", the system returns P(AI) = 0.9985, because an all-NaN input scores 0.9995 in a learner never fitted with missingness. The three AIDE checkpoints fail together, sharing one preprocessing path. A quorum rule requiring two distinct architectures prevents both failures with no retraining.
  We also find Corpus A carries a class-conditional JPEG bias severe enough to separate the classes from the header alone, which limits every in-domain number we report. Code, harness, hash-identified artifacts and all corrections are released.

</details>


### [54] [Dimension-Specific Imbalance and an Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy for Multi-Task Affective State Recognition in Classroom Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31750)
*Xiangqian Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出DAiSEE上类别不平衡本质是"维度特定"现象，提出自适应混合标签策略（AHLS），在轻量网络上取得四维度最高平均Macro-F1 47.70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 课堂视频中学生情感状态识别受类别不平衡约束，但已有工作对其真实性质分析不足。作者认为现有统一处理方式（激进重加权、focal loss、统一二值简化）忽略了不平衡在不同情感维度上的结构差异，导致处理失败方式随维度而异。

Method: 提出自适应混合标签策略（AHLS）：对不平衡程度可控的维度采用四级分类，对严重长尾维度采用二值分类；并引入空类占位机制（null-class placeholder），将四个维度的最大有效逆频率权重比从约79×压缩至至多约8.5×，以稳定多任务优化。验证平台为轻量级FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN架构（0.39 M参数，0.07 G FLOPs）。

Result: 在DAiSEE上，该方法在四个情感维度的平均Macro-F1达47.70%，为11种对比方法中最高，对比对象包括5种SOTA深度模型（参数量最高为其167倍）与5种传统机器学习基线。跨模型行为分析表明，在此设定下分类策略对少数类状态识别的影响可能强于单纯扩展骨干网络。此外报告了DAiSEE在少数情感状态上存在标注密度限制的证据。

Conclusion: 类别不平衡应作为维度特定现象建模；策略层面的设计（而非仅增加模型容量）对少数类识别更关键；同时基准数据集本身的标注密度可能构成未来进展的上界，提示基准设计的重要性不亚于算法改进。

Abstract: Recognition of student affective states from classroom video is constrained by a class imbalance problem whose true nature is, we argue, under-analyzed. We show that on DAiSEE -- the de facto benchmark for this task -- class imbalance is fundamentally a dimension-specific phenomenon: raw imbalance ratios reach as high as approximately 79:1 (Frustration), and the structure of imbalance -- not only its magnitude -- varies across dimensions, so uniform algorithmic treatments (aggressive class reweighting, focal loss, uniform binary simplification) fail in dimension-dependent ways. We propose the Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy (AHLS), which assigns four-level classification to dimensions with manageable imbalance and binary classification to severely long-tailed dimensions, coupled with a null-class placeholder mechanism that stabilizes multi-task optimization by compressing the maximum effective inverse-frequency weight ratio from as high as ~79$\times$ to at most ~8.5$\times$ across the four dimensions. Validated on a lightweight FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN architecture (0.39 M parameters, 0.07 G FLOPs), the strategy attains the highest mean Macro-F1 of 47.70% across all four affective dimensions among 11 compared methods, including five state-of-the-art deep models (up to 167$\times$ larger) and five traditional machine-learning baselines. A cross-model behavioral analysis on DAiSEE indicates that, in this setting, classification strategy may influence minority-state recognition more strongly than further backbone scaling alone. We also report evidence of an annotation-density limitation of DAiSEE on minority affective states, which suggests that benchmark design may bound future progress as much as algorithmic refinement. Index Terms Affective computing, classroom video analysis, class imbalance, multi-task learning, lightweight deep learning, DAiSEE, engagement recognition.

</details>


### [55] [EgoTSR++: Egocentric Spatiotemporal Reasoning for Task Progress Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31751)
*Xiaoda Yang,Can Wang,Yuxiang Liu,Pengfei Zhou,Jianwen Lou,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出EgoTSR统一框架，用于诊断并提升视觉语言模型（VLMs）在自我中心任务进展理解中的顺序鲁棒性，通过新基准SpatialLogic-Bench、双向监督数据构建流程以及CoT-to-Tag渐进式课程，实现高精度且无输入顺序偏置的任务状态比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLMs在静态视觉理解上进展迅速，但在判断自我中心任务进展时不可靠。模型倾向依赖时间戳或呈现顺序等时间捷径，而非任务相关物体配置与空间关系。在操作任务中，重试、纠正动作和临时回退使进展本质非单调，因此需要诊断并改进模型的顺序鲁棒任务进展理解能力。

Method: 提出EgoTSR统一框架，包含三部分：1）SpatialLogic-Bench基准，对每个物理状态对在原始与顺序交换两种呈现下、覆盖短时与长时设置进行评估，以检验模型是否依赖任务状态证据还是时间捷径；2）数据构建流程，将成功且近似单调的操作与第一人称轨迹转化为双向监督，LongTag保留中间子任务结构以支持长时比较，failure-aware数据将学习扩展到回退与恢复情形；3）渐进式CoT-to-Tag课程，先监督基于证据的任务相关状态变化解释，再通过可扩展的仅标签训练巩固比较规则。

Result: 实验揭示代表性VLMs存在显著输入顺序偏置。EgoTSR在长时设置下达到92.4%准确率，前向-逆向差距仅0.1个百分点。failure-aware监督在非单调轨迹上进一步提升准确率11.8个百分点，恢复准确率提升11.2个百分点，同时保持广泛的视觉与空间能力。

Conclusion: 结果表明，目标条件状态比较可作为自我中心时空推理用于任务进展理解的显式形式化表述，EgoTSR有效缓解输入顺序偏置并提升非单调场景下的进展判断能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in static visual understanding, yet remain unreliable when judging how an egocentric task is progressing. Given a task instruction and two visual observations, a model should determine which state is closer to the goal by analyzing task-relevant object configurations and spatial relations, rather than relying on timestamps or presentation order. This distinction is critical in manipulation, where retries, corrective actions, and temporary regressions make progress inherently non-monotonic. We introduce EgoTSR, a unified framework for diagnosing and improving order-robust task-progress understanding. First, SpatialLogic-Bench evaluates each physical state pair in both original and order-swapped presentations across short- and long-horizon settings, exposing whether a model follows task-state evidence or chronological shortcuts. Second, our data construction pipeline converts successful, approximately monotonic manipulation and first-person trajectories into bidirectional supervision; LongTag further preserves intermediate subtask structure for long-horizon comparison, while failure-aware data extend learning to regressions and recoveries. Third, a progressive CoT-to-Tag curriculum first supervises evidence-grounded interpretation of task-relevant state changes and then consolidates the comparison rule through scalable label-only training. Experiments reveal substantial input-order bias in representative VLMs. EgoTSR achieves 92.4% long-horizon accuracy with a 0.1-point forward-inverse Gap. Failure-aware supervision further improves accuracy on non-monotonic trajectories by 11.8 points and Recovery Accuracy by 11.2 points, while maintaining broad visual and spatial capabilities. These results establish goal-conditioned state comparison as an explicit formulation of egocentric spatiotemporal reasoning for task-progress understanding.

</details>


### [56] [Calibration-Free Surface Normals Estimation in Vision-Based Tactile Sensing using Universal Photometric Stereo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31754)
*Zdravko Dugonjic,Stefanie Speidel,Roberto Calandra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需标定的触觉表面法向估计方法，利用通用光度立体（Universal Photometric Stereo）神经网络直接从触觉图像估计接触面法向，在3种不同光学系统的传感器上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视触觉传感器需通过物理按压已知几何探头并标定图像到真实形状的映射，才能获得高精度接触面法向与深度；该类标定难以跨传感器扩展，且随传感器形状与光学系统复杂度增加而愈发困难。作者希望免除标定并实现跨传感器可迁移的触觉感知。

Method: 采用通用光度立体神经网络，以纯合成数据训练模型，实现标定自由的接触面法向估计；在3种不同光学系统的传感器上开展真实实验，并与标定基线进行对比，包括金属球受控实验及自然纹理物体实验。

Abstract: Vision-based tactile sensors are a popular solution for capturing rich contact surface geometry. However, to obtain high-detail contact surface normals and depth, it is necessary to calibrate the sensor by physically pressing a probe with known geometry against the sensor elastomer and mapping tactile images onto the ground truth probe's shape. This approach does not scale across different tactile sensors, and the calibration effort can be complex depending on the sensor shape and optical system. Instead, we propose a calibration-free procedure for the estimation of contact surface normals using Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks. In a series of real-world experiments, we evaluate our approach on 3 sensors with different optical systems, demonstrating that universal methods are a suitable approach for estimating surface normals at the contact patch from tactile images, thereby alleviating the need for tactile sensor calibration. Controlled experiments with a metal ball show that universal methods match the calibrated method, with a mean angular error of $6.56^{\Large\circ}$. We show that the proposed framework recovers high-frequency surface details of objects with natural textures, achieving an overall mean angular error of $10.66^{\Large\circ}$. Universal method robustly recovers the contact surface normals captured with dome-shaped Digit 360, achieving a low angular discrepancy of $10.18^{\Large\circ}$ relative to the calibrated baseline. This experiment demonstrates that with sufficient illumination settings surface normals could be estimated using a model trained solely on synthetic data. By providing a unified representation of contact surfaces across different vision-based tactile sensor designs, Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks lay the foundation for transferable tactile perception across sensors.

</details>


### [57] [Gauge-Equivariant Attention for Rotation-Stable $360^\circ$ Scene Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31755)
*Tianjian Zhou,Yishan Li,Jie Jiang,Yifei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文针对全景（360°）场景理解中icosphere transformer的规范依赖性缺陷，提出规范等变相对位置编码（GE-RPE），并构建EquiSSL框架，显著提升旋转鲁棒性与低标签微调性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景360°场景理解日益依赖icosphere transformer，但现有最先进球面模型在相机旋转90°时分割精度下降超过一半。受控消融实验表明，其相对位置偏置中的规范依赖性（gauge dependence）是主要原因，因此需要一种在规范旋转下保持等变/不变性的位置编码方案。

Method: 提出GE-RPE（gauge-equivariant relative position encoding）：对偏置在规范旋转的有限循环子群C_n⊂SO(2)上做无参数的Reynolds平均。将其嵌入SphereUFormer骨干；在等变SSL中进一步引入教师token置换π_R，使自监督视图与旋转后的学生帧对齐，构成EquiSSL框架（GE-RPE + π_R + iBOT+MAE）。理论上证明该构造具有C_n不变性，并以O(n^{-2})逼近连续SO(2)平均。

Result: GE-RPE零新增参数，前向延迟仅增加1.5%–4.4%；三种子匹配模型精度下降仅1.3%，而已发布SphereUFormer检查点在同一压力协议下下降53%（训练配方不同）。EquiSSL将下降收紧至0.8%，验证mIoU达68.30%；1%标签微调在N=373测试集上提升+2.39 mIoU（N=40验证集上+4.10）。该修复同样适用于单目深度和零样本Structured3D分割。

Conclusion: 通过消除规范缺陷并借助π_R对齐SSL视图，iBOT+MAE预训练从负担转变为干净的低标签杠杆。该模型可作为一种可用的360°视觉计算原语，适用于全景重光照、沉浸式视频与跨数据集迁移。

Abstract: Panoramic $360^\circ$ scene understanding increasingly relies on icosphere transformers, but a state-of-the-art spherical model loses more than half of its segmentation accuracy when the camera rotates by $90^\circ$, and controlled ablations identify gauge dependence in its relative-position bias as a major contributor. We propose gauge-equivariant relative position encoding (GE-RPE): a parameter-free Reynolds average of the bias over a finite cyclic subgroup $C_n\!\subset\!\mathrm{SO}(2)$ of gauge rotations. Plugged into a SphereUFormer backbone the change is invisible at deployment---zero added parameters and $1.5$--$4.4\%$ forward latency---and the matched three-seed GE-RPE model records a $1.3\%$ drop; the published SphereUFormer checkpoint records $53\%$ under the same stress protocol but a different training recipe. Once the gauge defect is removed and a teacher-token permutation $π_R$ aligns the SSL views to the rotated student frame, iBOT$+$MAE pretraining stops being a liability and becomes a clean low-label lever: the full framework EquiSSL (GE-RPE $+$ $π_R$ $+$ iBOT$+$MAE) tightens the drop to $0.8\%$ at $68.30\%$ val mIoU and lifts $1\%$-label fine-tuning by $+2.39$ mIoU on the $N{=}373$ test split (and by $+4.10$ on the smaller $N{=}40$ val split); the same fix carries over to monocular depth and to zero-shot Structured3D segmentation. The construction is provably $C_n$-invariant and $\mathcal{O}(n^{-2})$-close to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ average, making the resulting model a usable $360^\circ$ visual-computing primitive across panoramic relighting, immersive video, and cross-dataset transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaywalk18/equissl-release.

</details>


### [58] [3dgs-sc: a controlled static screen-content benchmark for 3d gaussian splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31756)
*Shicheng Cai,Hao Zhang,Dong Dai,Xuerui Ma,Ying Hu,Tao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出3DGS-SC——一个受控的静态屏幕内容数据集与基准，用于检验3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）中"高图像保真度是否等价于可读屏幕内容"的错位问题。基准将评测分为整图保真度、屏幕区域保真度、OCR可读性与边缘保持四个维度。在五方法对比中，屏幕PSNR与OCR排序在十组方法对中有七组不一致，揭示了仅依赖保真度评测的方法选择失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3DGS重建通常以PSNR等整图像保真度指标评价，但屏幕等含文本区域的可用性取决于可读性而非像素平均误差。既有文本感知3DGS研究未提供受控、精确标注的显示器界面评测场景，因此"高保真度是否意味着可读屏幕内容"这一关键问题缺乏系统验证手段。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage styling iterations where a large number of candidate geometries must be evaluated. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, physics-aware slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and SUVs, achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56% (sedans) and 2.12% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference.   <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 方向性多尺度覆盖提供了一种紧凑、可解释的局部表示，能有效捕捉上下文图像误用中的决定性局部不匹配，并在防泄漏评估下优于现有迁移方法。

Abstract: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代文生图模型虽能生成高保真图像，但在需要实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间排序和角色敏感关系的组合式提示上仍表现不足；现有方法多将结构化信息作为外部控制信号或事后解析，未将其作为内在潜变量建模。

Method: 提出 PSP-DiT：将全景场景程序作为一等潜变量，采用耦合的 Transformer 流对图像潜变量与场景程序潜变量进行联合去噪，并引入全景 grounding 与循环一致性目标，将对象实例、属性、关系和计数与生成图像中的视觉证据对齐。

Conclusion: 将全景场景程序作为一等潜变量并与图像潜变量联合去噪，是提升文生图组合性建模的有效途径，在保持图像质量的同时显著改善结构化提示的理解与生成能力。

Abstract: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. </details>


### [62] [SelfCue: Making a 3D CT Report Generator Say What It Already Knows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31788)
*Renjie Liang,Yang Yang,Jinqian Pan,Zhengkang Fan,Chengkun Sun,Jie Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现3D CT报告生成器的隐状态已编码报告所遗漏的异常信息（macro AUROC 0.848），但在解码为文本时丢失（降至0.739）。为此提出基于对比解码的SelfCue方法，促进隐状态已支持的输出、抑制不支持的输出，并提出SelfCue-KD蒸馏版本，在推理阶段无额外开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前3D CT报告生成的研究主要依赖更复杂的架构和更大的训练数据，但论文发现报告生成器的隐状态中其实已包含报告遗漏的信息，只是当隐状态被转化为token（文本）时这部分信息丢失了。这存在"隐状态到报告"的表达缺口。

Method: 提出SelfCue，基于对比解码（contrastive decoding）：促进隐状态已支持的输出，抑制隐状态不支持的输出。并将该行为蒸馏到权重中得到SelfCue-KD。

Conclusion: 报告生成器已"知道"其报告遗漏的内容，关键不在于扩大架构或数据，而在于弥合隐状态到报告的表达缺口。SelfCue及SelfCue-KD有效提升了报告质量且落地成本低。

Abstract: Progress in 3D CT report generation is usually sought in increasingly sophisticated architectures and larger pools of training data. We find instead that a 3D CT report generator already holds what its report leaves out, and loses it when the hidden state becomes tokens. Over the 18 CT-RATE abnormalities, this hidden-to-report surfacing gap is reflected by a drop in macro AUROC from 0.848 in the hidden states to 0.739 in the generated report. We propose SelfCue based on contrastive decoding. It promotes what the hidden state already supports and suppresses what it does not. It raises clinical efficacy F1 to 0.481 and the LLM-judged GREEN score to 0.510. Distilling that behaviour into the weights gives SelfCue-KD, a student that keeps most of the gain, needs nothing extra at inference, and drops into any pipeline already serving the baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/SelfCue-CT.

</details>


### [63] [Rate-Adaptive One-Step Diffusion Compression for AIGC Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31795)
*Nitiz Khanal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文报告 LoViF 2026 AIGC 图像压缩挑战赛参赛方案：基于 AEIC 一步扩散编解码器微调四个码率专用检查点，结合 TTO 潜变量精修与 rANS 熵编码，通过精确多重选择背包在真实码流尺寸上为每图选一条码流，最终以 0.02495 BPP 取得 PSNR 27.02 dB、DISTS 0.0390，总榜第 5、DISTS 第 2。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 0.025 BPP 的严格全局码率预算下压缩 AI 生成图像具有独特困难：此类图像常含渲染文字、合成边缘、重复母题、类 UI 布局与风格化微纹理，传统失真导向编解码器在该码率下会将其抹除；而无约束生成式解码器虽能恢复看似合理的细节，却会偏离源几何结构与符号内容。因此作者将该问题重新定义为"码率—感知分配"问题，而非单纯的失真最小化。

Method: 1) 微调 AEIC 一步扩散编解码器的四个码率专用检查点；2) 由四个检查点生成逐图候选，其中一条潜变量经编码器侧测试时优化（TTO）并周期性刷新熵条件；3) 用实用 rANS 对全部候选进行熵编码；4) 以真实编码文件尺寸为权重，将每图恰好选一条码流建模为精确多重选择背包问题求解；5) 解码端施加零额外比特的固定残差复原网络；所有提交码流均可由随附解码器独立解码，不使用源图或外部边信息。另报告了 77 次日志实验的消融历史与负结果。

Result: 最终提交得分 31.527739，在 0.02495 BPP 下取得 PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390；DISTS 在排行榜列第 2，最终测试阶段总榜排名第 5（2026 年 8 月 4 日公布）。

Conclusion: 该方案在超低码率 AIGC 图像压缩上具备竞争力，尤其在感知指标 DISTS 上表现突出。作者同时报告负结果，说明在该架构下 PSNR 难以追平失真导向型竞争对手，并指出未来改进方向（如码率—感知联合分配、TTO 与熵条件刷新策略），对后续参赛者具有参考价值。

Abstract: We describe our entry to the LoViF 2026 AIGC Image Compression Challenge, a benchmark for ultra-low-bitrate coding of AI-generated images under a strict global rate budget of 0.025 bits per pixel (BPP). Generated imagery poses a distinct challenge for compression: it frequently contains rendered typography, synthetic edges, repeated motifs, UI-like layout, and stylized micro-texture that conventional distortion-oriented codecs erase at this rate, while unconstrained generative decoders can restore plausible-looking detail that no longer matches the source geometry or symbols. We treat this as a rate-perception allocation problem. Our system fine-tunes four rate-specialized checkpoints of the AEIC one-step diffusion codec, generates per-image candidates from all four, including one latent refined through encoder-side test-time optimization (TTO) with periodic entropy-conditioning refresh, entropy-codes every candidate with practical rANS coding, and selects exactly one bitstream per image with an exact multiple-choice knapsack solved over true coded file sizes. A fixed, zero-additional-bit residual restoration network is applied at decode time. Every submitted bitstream is independently decodable by the shipped decoder, which uses no source image or external side information. We report the full pipeline, an ablation history spanning 77 logged experiments, and a set of negative results, including why PSNR could not be pushed to parity with rate-distortion-oriented competitors under this architecture, useful to future participants. This is a challenge report: our entry scored 31.527739 (PSNR 27.02 dB, MS-SSIM 0.9176, LPIPS 0.0778, DISTS 0.0390 at 0.02495 BPP), the second-best DISTS on the leaderboard, ranking 5th on the final test-phase leaderboard announced August 4, 2026.

</details>

*Florian Philipp Stilz,Lorenzo Arboit,Vinkle Srivastav,CAMMA International Surgical Partners,Jacques Marescaux,Sergio Alfieri,Pietro Mascagni,Nassir Navab,Nicolas Padoy*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外科AI领域专家标注成本高、获取困难，标签高效建模成为核心挑战；自监督基础模型虽能以少量数据适配新任务，但标签效率在不同外科任务间的差异尚未被系统探索。

Method: 构建迄今最大规模的外科预训练数据集SurgSpectrum-30M+（超3000万帧），训练外科基础模型SURGE并发布检查点；在5个任务类别、15个基准上系统评测标签效率，任务范围从时间与空间场景理解，到与器械—解剖交互及安全关键操作相关的细粒度推理。

Conclusion: 标签效率具有任务依赖性，为在复杂领域中合理分配专家标注投入提供了指导蓝图；同时公开数据集检查点与代码以推动后续研究。

Abstract: Developing label-efficient models is a central challenge in surgical AI due to the high cost and scarcity of expert annotation. While self-supervised foundation models adapt well to new tasks with minimal data, how label efficiency varies across different surgical tasks remains largely unexplored.
  Here, we introduce SURGE, a surgical foundation model trained on SurgSpectrum-30M+, the largest pretraining dataset comprising over 30 million frames, with checkpoints released to enable further research. We systematically evaluate label efficiency across 5 task categories and 15 benchmarks. These range from temporal and spatial scene understanding to fine-grained reasoning tied to instrument-anatomy interactions and safety-critical maneuvers.
  SURGE outperforms prior state-of-the-art on all benchmarks, even surpassing task-specific models on complex reasoning tasks. Crucially, we reveal a task-dependent scaling behavior: while scene understanding tasks saturate with minimal supervision, fine-grained reasoning tasks continue improving with substantially larger annotation budgets, providing a blueprint for allocating expert effort in complex domains.
  Code: https://github.com/CAMMA-public/SURGE

</details>

*Jeremy Stephen Gabriel Yee,Zhengkui Wang,Zhiyuan Zhang,Avinash Anand,Timothy Liu,Benedict Chan,Aik Beng Ng,Simon See*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM评估大多假设理想视觉输入，无法刻画相机距离、光照、视角和像素密度等物理成像条件如何影响语义可恢复性，导致对其在真实感知约束下的可靠性认识不足。

Method: 构建可控合成流水线，按物理可解释的像素密度区间系统变化观测距离、光照、相机几何与动作姿态，生成超54k QA对；并提出可辨识性标注框架，利用掩码条件统计特征与集成学习传播人类感知标签。

Conclusion: SynDORBench建立了物理可解释的多模态评估新范式，支持在真实感知约束下系统分析LVLM可靠性，并可与人类可见性阈值直接对比。

Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their perceptual reliability under physically constrained imaging conditions remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations predominantly assume ideal visual inputs and therefore fail to characterize how camera distance, illumination, viewpoint, and pixel density fundamentally affect semantic recoverability. We introduce SynDORBench, the first physically grounded benchmark for evaluating LVLM perceptual robustness under DORI-calibrated conditions aligned with human visual capability standards. SynDORBench comprises over 54k question--answer pairs generated through a controllable synthetic pipeline that systematically varies viewing distance, lighting, camera geometry, and action pose according to physically interpretable pixel-density regimes. To support scalable low-visibility supervision, we further propose a discernibility annotation framework that propagates human perceptual labels using mask-conditioned statistical features and ensemble learning. We evaluate 16 open-source LVLMs, a commercial LVLM baseline, and YOLO11x across human-presence classification and action recognition tasks under progressively degraded visibility conditions. Our results reveal that perceptual failure in LVLMs is strongly governed by pixel density and physical imaging constraints rather than model scale alone. Surprisingly, several compact open-source LVLMs outperform larger commercial baselines and substantially exceed YOLO11x robustness under long-range and low-light conditions. SynDORBench establishes a new benchmark paradigm for physically grounded multimodal evaluation, enabling systematic analysis of LVLM reliability under real-world perceptual constraints and direct comparison against human visibility thresholds.

</details>


### [66] [CueKFS: Agentic Cue-Driven Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31873)
*Weitai Kang,Hanieh Deilamsalehy,Yumo Xu,Dewang Sultania,Serdar Cellat,Yan Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的视频关键帧选择方法 CueKFS，将问题-帧匹配转化为动态生成视觉线索的探测过程，在三个基准的 27 个设置上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频问答中，关键帧选择可替代均匀采样以选取与问题更相关的帧。现有方法多按帧与问题的相似度排序，但当问题组合了单帧无法呈现的主体或时刻、或依赖字面未含的隐含信息时，相关帧得分可能偏低；将问题拆分为子查询的方法又因静态初始上下文导致分解不准。

Method: CueKFS 为免训练方法，把问题-帧匹配重构为"帧与动态生成视觉线索集合"的比对。从初始显著帧集出发，将问题分解为线索；每条线索并行探测视频以定位自身证据；推理 VLM 以 agent 方式依据证据修订线索集并重新探索视频；最后在存留线索间分配预算。

Result: 在三个基准上，CueKFS 在所有 27 个有公开对比结果的设置中均达 SOTA，预算平均提升最高 +4.54%，VLM 调用次数中位数仅为 2 次。行为分析显示，agent 式线索细化驱动主动重探索，相较初始上下文相对相似度提升最高达 92%。

Conclusion: 以动态视觉线索替代静态相似度排序与静态子查询分解，可有效提升长视频问答的关键帧选择效果，且调用开销低、无需训练。

Abstract: Keyframe selection (KFS) has long produced compact video summaries for browsing and retrieval, and representative frames for thumbnails. More recently, when conditioned on a question, KFS provides an alternative to uniform sampling for long-video question answering by selecting frames that are more relevant to the question. Most methods rank frames by similarity to the question. Yet a relevant frame may score poorly when the question combines subjects or moments that no single frame shows, or requires implicit information absent from its wording. Other methods try to break down the question into subqueries, but suffer from inaccurate decomposition due to their static initial context. Therefore, we propose CueKFS, a training-free method that reformulates question--frame matching as comparing frames against a set of dynamically generated visual cues. From an initial set of salient frames, we decompose the question into cues. Each cue concurrently probes the video to navigate to its own evidence. A reasoning VLM then agentically revises the cue set against its evidence to re-explore the video. CueKFS then allocates the budget across the surviving cues. Across three benchmarks, CueKFS establishes state-of-the-art results in all 27 evaluated settings with available prior results, achieving budget-averaged gains of up to +4.54% over the previous baseline and a median of only two VLM calls. We further provide a detailed behavioral analysis of CueKFS, showing that agentic cue refinement drives active re-exploration of the video, yielding relative similarity gains of up to 92% over the initial context.

</details>


### [67] [Auditing Quality Filters for Long-Tail Human Data Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31896)
*Rishav Agarwal,Nirshal Chandra Sekar,Anirudh Vemula*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 工人跪姿/弯腰等"低姿态"在自动标注流程中被质量过滤器更频繁地剔除，占保留样本仅约2%；四类姿态线索与仿真实验均表明低姿态稀缺且难以检测，边界框与姿态信息不足以支撑长尾人体数据治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑工地机器人需检测跪姿或弯腰作业的工人（低姿态），但此类样本在自动标注的训练数据集中容易丢失，导致长尾人体数据稀缺、检测性能不足，因此需要厘清低姿态缺失是数据本身稀少还是流程过滤所致。

Method: 研究一条包含人体检测、NLF关节估计与相似姿态分组的处理流水线；用四种替代姿态线索（边界框形状、身体垂直跨度、与场景垂直方向对齐的姿态分组、图像外观）检验质量过滤对低姿态的影响；并构建可控仿真场景，将微调于公开建筑数据集的人体检测器在低姿态与站立姿态边界框高度匹配条件下进行对比。

Result: 低姿态仅占保留样本约2%；四种线索一致表明低姿态更易被过滤器拒绝；仿真实验中，即使将边界框高度校正至与站立工人一致，检测器仍在低姿态上漏检更多工人。

Conclusion: 低姿态样本既稀缺又难以发现，边界框或姿态信息均不足以支撑长尾人体数据的治理，需针对低姿态设计更可靠的采集与筛选策略。

Abstract: Robots on construction sites must detect workers who are kneeling or bending, which we call low poses. These workers can be lost from training datasets during automatic labeling. We study a pipeline that detects people, estimates their body joints using NLF, and groups similar poses. Low poses account for only about 2 percent of the retained examples. This low share may partly reflect the pipeline's quality filter, which rejects examples with low detection confidence or uncertain joint estimates. We examine this filtering using four alternative pose clues: bounding-box shape, vertical body span, pose grouping aligned to the scene's vertical direction, and image appearance. All four suggest that low poses are rejected by the filter more often. Separately, controlled simulated scenes show that a person detector fine-tuned on a public construction dataset misses more workers in these poses even when we correct their bounding box height is matched to that of standing workers. These findings suggest that low poses are scarce and hard to find, and we cannot rely on bounding boxes or poses for long-tail human data curation.

</details>


### [68] [Enhancing Visual Reasoning in Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31911)
*Denis Musinguzi,Andrew Katumba,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种通过整合解剖区域、边界框与区域级文本描述来验证推理过程的医学报告生成框架，设计空间与事实奖励机制，结合SFT与RL提升临床正确性、可解释性并识别奖励劫持模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学报告生成中幻觉问题突出，根源在于监督微调（SFT）偏好与参考报告的词汇相似度而非临床正确性；而强化学习虽在数学、代码等可验证奖励领域表现良好，但在开放式医学任务中应用有限，且现有工作只评估最终答案、忽视推理过程，而错误推理会拖累整体性能。

Method: 以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为基座，先用SFT适配医学领域，再通过冷启动SFT引入推理能力，最后用强化学习精调。构建整合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述的推理验证框架，设计空间奖励与事实奖励机制，确保推理视觉有据且事实准确。

Result: RL相比仅用SFT带来额外性能增益；同时验证推理步骤与最终输出比单独验证任一者提升更大；在RL阶段识别出多种奖励劫持模式；模型的结构化思维链增强了可解释性，使输出更易审计。

Conclusion: 在医学报告生成中，将推理过程纳入验证并联合优化推理与输出，可有效缓解幻觉、提升临床正确性与可解释性；同时需警惕RL阶段奖励劫持问题，结构化思维痕迹有利于临床审计。

Abstract: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.

</details>


### [69] [PredRA: Fast Medical Image Translation by Deterministic Component Extraction and Controlled Stochastic Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31912)
*Jianhai Zhang,Pattarawut Charatpangoon,Donghao Zhang,Bijoy K. Menon,Wu Qiu,M. Ethan MacDonald,Aravind Ganesh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PredRA 将残差生成过程视为优化问题，把确定性预测作为稳定参考，并从中提取额外确定性残差成分，同时全局控制残差精炼量，实现快速、保真且感知质量强的医学图像翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强配对医学图像翻译中，大量成分可直接从源图预测。纯确定性预测会平滑细节，而生成模型虽能恢复细节，却可能引入不必要甚至有害的变化。因此需要在保持感知质量的同时提升保真度。

Method: 提出 PredRA 框架：以确定性预测为稳定参考，在生成式精炼过程中从残差里提取额外确定性成分；将整个基于残差的生成过程建模为优化问题，并推导出实用解，通过受控精炼恢复有用残差细节，同时使预测接近配对目标。由于残差有用性在体素级难以可靠估计，采用全局控制残差精炼的添加量，以减少不必要不确定性的累积。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上验证，受控精炼相比完整残差精炼提升了与配对目标的保真度，同时保留大部分生成建模的感知收益。PredRA 以少 1.4–11.9 倍的总参数和少 3.1–26.2 倍的可训练参数，取得与更大规模先进模型相当或更优的性能；其 32 步流采样器所需采样步数比匹配的 1000 步 DDPM 少 31.25 倍。

Conclusion: PredRA 将确定性成分提取与受控随机精炼结合，实现快速、保真且感知质量强的医学图像翻译，在参数效率和采样效率上均显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Strongly paired medical image translation contains a substantial component that can be predicted directly from the source. The current reality is that pure deterministic prediction can smooth away fine detail, while generative models can recover detail but may also introduce unnecessary or potentially harmful variation. We propose PredRA, a fast framework that uses the deterministic prediction as a stable reference and further extracts additional deterministic components from the residual during generative refinement, thereby improving fidelity while maintaining perceptual quality. The goal is simple: we view the entire residual-based generative process as an optimization problem and derive a practical solution that recovers useful residual detail through controlled refinement while keeping the prediction close to the paired target. Mechanism studies further show that useful residual information follows structured patterns, but its usefulness is difficult to estimate reliably at the voxel level. We therefore globally control how much of the residual refinement is added to the deterministic prediction, thereby reducing the accumulation of unnecessary uncertainty. PredRA therefore combines deterministic component extraction with controlled stochastic refinement for fast, fidelity-preserving, and perceptually strong medical image translation. We validate the approach across multiple real-world datasets, showing that controlled refinement improves fidelity to the paired target compared with full residual refinement while retaining much of the perceptual benefit of generative modeling. PredRA achieves competitive or superior performance to substantially larger state-of-the-art models with 1.4-11.9x fewer total parameters and 3.1-26.2x fewer trainable parameters, while its 32-step flow sampler requires 31.25x fewer sampling steps than the matched 1000-step DDPM.

</details>

Abstract: Hybrid quantum methods have received limited study for resource-constrained facial biometrics. We present a hybrid quantum-classical facial recognition pipeline designed to run on standard computing hardware. Images undergo gamma correction, contrast enhancement, and principal component analysis before their features are encoded into an eight-qubit variational quantum classifier. Classical image matching then performs recognition. ### [71] [CaptchaArena: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Dataset for Training Computer-Use Agents on Interactive CAPTCHAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31957)
*Zhenhao Zhang,Zhaoyu Fan,Haohan Ying,Jingwen Hu,Hancen Fan,Junhao Zhou,Zitian Chen,Linchao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了首个大规模、细粒度交互式验证码求解训练数据集 CaptchaArena（50K 谜题、20 种类型、5 种交互模式、执行验证、50K 轨迹与像素掩码标注），并据此训练统一 9B 策略模型 CaptchaAgent，经 SFT+RL 达到 71.7 Pass@1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式 CAPTCHA 对 computer-use agent 仍具挑战，而现有数据集在类型覆盖、交互保真度与轨迹监督之间存在取舍，缺乏兼顾三者的资源。

Method: 构建 CaptchaArena：50K 谜题覆盖 20 种 CAPTCHA 类型和 5 种交互模式，每个解答均经执行验证；提供 50K 截图-动作轨迹（其中 46K 含逐步推理标注）及针对不规则目标的细粒度像素掩码标注。基于该数据训练 CaptchaAgent，用单一 9B 策略覆盖全部 20 种类型，采用监督微调（SFT）后接强化学习（RL），RL 奖励由环境验证器直接提供。

Abstract: Interactive CAPTCHAs remain challenging for computer-use agents, while existing datasets face trade-offs among type coverage, interaction fidelity, and trajectory supervision. To address these gaps, we present CaptchaArena, the first large-scale, fine-grained training dataset for interactive CAPTCHA solving. It contains 50K puzzles across 20 CAPTCHA types and 5 interaction modes, with every solution verified through execution. CaptchaArena provides 50K screenshot-action trajectories, including 46K with step-by-step reasoning annotations. It also includes fine-grained pixel-mask annotations for irregular targets. Using CaptchaArena, we train CaptchaAgent, a single 9B policy for all 20 CAPTCHA types, with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. The environment verifier directly provides the RL reward. Supervised fine-tuning reaches 70.5 Pass@1, and reinforcement learning further improves it to 71.7, while also improving performance on two external benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of large-scale, fine-grained computer-use supervision for training interactive CAPTCHA agents. We release CaptchaArena and CaptchaAgent at https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena.

</details>


### [72] [Double-Edged Sword of Mediated Visibility: How Visual Framing Undermines Congresswomen's Perceived Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31970)
*Bryce J. Dietrich,Hyein Ko,Myriam Shiran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究通过面部识别分析695,464条CNN与Fox News图像-文本片段（2011-2021）并结合两项预注册实验（N=6,220），发现国会女性更多以分屏（而非单人镜头）出现；静态分屏会降低女性议员被感知的政治能力但不影响男性议员，动态视频中该惩罚消失，而愤怒语言对女性温暖度的削弱约为男性的三倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 女性在国会的比例长期停滞于30%以下，这种制度性代表不足同样体现在电视新闻的低可见度上，而视觉呈现会影响公众对能力与权威的感知。既有研究多关注女性议员是否出现，而较少探讨其"如何被视觉框定"，因此需要考察视觉框架如何塑造女性议员的媒介可见度与被感知能力。

Method: （1）对CNN与Fox News 2011-2021年间695,464条图像-文本片段进行面部识别分析；（2）开展两项预注册实验，共6,220名被试，比较静态帧与动态视频中分屏/单人镜头框架及愤怒语言对不同性别议员感知评价的影响。

Result: 女性议员在分屏（而非单人）镜头中出现的比例显著偏高。静态帧下，分屏框架降低女性议员被感知的政治能力，但对男性议员无此影响；在动态视频中该能力惩罚消失，转而由愤怒语言降低女性议员的温暖度，其幅度约为男性议员的三倍。此外，提示性证据（p = .057）显示女性观众在观看女性议员单人出现后报告更高的外部政治效能感。

Conclusion: 视觉框架同时塑造了女性国会议员的媒介可见度与其被感知的能力，分屏等呈现方式对女性存在不对称的负面影响；研究提示媒介呈现规范与性别平等报道具有重要意义。

Abstract: Women's presence in Congress has stalled below 30%. That institutional underrepresentation is mirrored by their limited visibility on televised news, where visual presentation can shape perceived competence and authority. Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.

</details>


### [73] [Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31985)
*Denis Musinguzi,Andrew Katumba,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过控制变量实验揭示视觉-语言预训练目标的监督粒度如何影响胸部X光解读性能：局部目标利于异常检测、全局目标利于分类，且标题生成与对比学习在不同粒度任务上的优势出现反转，不存在普适最优目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言预训练目标在监督的空间粒度上存在差异，但这种粒度分布对胸部X光解读任务的具体影响尚未被充分探索，缺乏受控、系统的实证研究。

Method: 固定编码器与预训练数据，仅改变预训练目标，训练九个目标（涵盖全局与局部对比学习、标题生成及其组合），并在五个空间粒度递增的胸部X光任务上进行评估。

Result: (i) 预训练粒度与任务粒度在两端对齐：局部目标在异常检测上领先，全局目标在分类上领先；(ii) 局部目标在全局级生成与问答任务上出人意料地具有竞争力；(iii) 标题生成与对比学习在不同粒度层级上的优势发生反转；(iv) 组合中，混合标题生成与对比监督在分类和分布内生成上最强，而两种标题生成目标配对在零样本报告生成上泛化最佳。

Conclusion: 不存在普适最优的预训练目标；目标类型、粒度与任务三者的交互共同决定下游性能。

Abstract: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.

</details>


### [74] [Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31998)
*Weida Zhao,Logan Bellamy,Yazhou Tu,Jiaqi Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种联邦学习框架，使多个站点在不共享原始图像的前提下协同训练模拟仪表读数模型，并发布MeterFL数据集用于系统评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟指针式仪表广泛部署于工业与公用事业场景，环境与表型多样且巡检数据可能敏感。传统自动抄表需针对每种环境和表型单独开发部署，而深度学习虽能应对多样性，却依赖大量昂贵的标注数据。实际中仪表图像分散于各独立站点，每站标注有限，且因所有权、治理或隐私限制，原始图像往往无法汇集共享。

Method: 提出面向视觉模拟仪表读数的联邦框架，支持多站点协同训练读数模型而不共享原始图像。框架包含四阶段流水线：(1) 表盘定位；(2) 跨客户端联邦训练的细结构分割；(3) 极坐标展开；(4) 用于最终读数的刻度计数解码。

Result: 发布MeterFL数据集，含1,382张带掩码标注图像，按视觉属性通过确定性规则组织为面向部署的伪客户端，并在分割训练/测试划分间采用dHash近重复控制。研究评估了分割质量和端到端读数准确率。数据集公开于 https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL。

Conclusion: 该工作以联邦学习范式解决分散站点仪表读数的数据孤岛与隐私约束问题，并提供可复现的基准数据集与系统性评估方案。

Abstract: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL.

</details>


### [75] [TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32013)
*Quinlan Sykora,Sourav Biswas,Christopher Diehl,Andrew Cunningham,Thomas Gilles,Raquel Urtasun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TriO 是一种多模态无监督世界模型，利用相机、LiDAR 和 RADAR 三种传感器同时作为输入与自监督来源，实现 4D 占用、障碍分割、光流与 LiDAR 预测，并在多项 3D/4D 任务上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型往往依赖人工标注，且开放集方法在长尾物体（罕见目标）分割上存在局限，难以从可行驶表面中区分任意占用。

Method: 提出 TriO：以相机、LiDAR、RADAR 三种模态作为输入，并相互提供自监督信号，无需额外人工标注；通过这种新颖的监督方式实现对任意占用的分割。

Result: 在多个 3D 与 4D 任务上达到最优，包括占用预测、光流预测、LiDAR 预测，以及在 Argoverse 2、Spotting the Unexpected 等数据集上的零样本道路障碍分割。

Conclusion: 多模态自监督可替代人工标注，并有效克服开放集方法在长尾物体上的不足，为统一的 4D 世界建模提供了可行路径。

Abstract: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

</details>


### [76] [Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32027)
*Xiaohao Xu,Xiaonan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 Depth Any Seen，将图像中沿射线的可见表面建模为条件化多伯努利深度集合，并用 ExactMB 目标联合学习深度与表面存在性；实验显示其在分层深度基准上显著降低过预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单张图像中沿一条射线可能有多个可见表面，恢复其可见三维结构需同时估计每个表面的存在与否以及度量深度，传统方法对此建模不足。

Method: 将可见表面表示为图像条件化的多伯努利深度集合，每个分量输出一个深度或保持缺失；采用无需辅助信息的 Exact Multi-Bernoulli（ExactMB）目标，通过对完整且互异的目标做一对一分配边缘化来学习深度与存在性。分析表明仅匹配期望计数会留下分量—表面分配歧义，因此进一步考察有序分配与计数正则化配置。

Result: 在扩展的 LD-Real 与 MD-3K 真实分层基准上，ExactMB 相比 depth stacking 将过预测分别相对降低 88.2% 与 80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度；在 LD-Syn 上条件度量深度误差相当。消融显示有序分配在深度正确的召回与精度上优于边缘化，而计数正则化配置在更低召回下获得更高的深层排序精度。

Conclusion: ExactMB 能有效抑制多表面深度估计中的过预测并缓解分配歧义，有序分配与计数正则化各有权衡，代码将公开。

Abstract: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

</details>


### [77] [ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32036)
*Chenyue Li,Xiaoxiao Sun,Yubo Deng,Qinlin Zhao,Serena Yeung-Levy,Yuhui Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 ScreenHaystack 基准，通过在高分辨率 GUI 背景中系统性移动同一目标图标来评估 GUI grounding 模型的空间可靠性，发现主流模型存在"盲区"，并据此提出盲区导向的数据增强策略以提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 评测通常将每个目标固定在特定位置进行测试，无法反映模型在空间维度上的一致性与可靠性，可能掩盖模型在部分空间区域定位能力严重退化的问题。

Method: 提出动态 needle-in-a-haystack 基准 ScreenHaystack：在保持目标图标外观与指令不变的前提下，将其系统性地迁移到高分辨率 GUI 背景的不同位置，测量模型定位的一致性；进一步通过受控合成实验分析训练数据空间覆盖不均对盲区形成的影响；最后提出盲区导向增强（blind-zone-oriented augmentation）策略，在盲区补充监督信号。

Result: Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus 等领先 GUI grounding 模型均存在定位准确率骤降的"盲区"；盲区可迁移到未见过的 ScreenSpot-Pro 样本，盲区内目标持续更难定位（Qwen3-VL-8B 下降 16.1 个百分点）；受控迁移实验表明将目标移入盲区会降低准确率，移出则提升；训练数据空间覆盖不均可诱发盲区；盲区导向增强在 Click-100k 微调基础上优于原始数据与随机增强。

Conclusion: GUI grounding 模型存在显著的空间盲区，且该现象与训练数据的空间覆盖不均相关；通过在盲区补充监督的针对性增强策略，可有效缓解盲区问题并提升 ScreenSpot-Pro 上的 grounding 准确率。

Abstract: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

</details>


### [78] [ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32038)
*Weikai Lin,Junjie Zhao,Carl Marshall,Sushant Kondguli,Yuhao Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ControlGS 提出一种面向 XR 的 3D 高斯渲染管线，将渲染输出到人眼之间的完整下游处理纳入优化目标，并可根据下游处理参数动态生成高斯原语，从而在不同神经高斯主干和数据集上持续提升端到端“后光学”视觉质量，且开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: XR 用户感知的不是渲染引擎的直接输出，而是经过后处理管线和物理显示-光学路径后的图像；该下游处理在运行时受相机位姿、显示功耗预算等影响而显著变化。传统 3DGS 方法要么默认该下游管线保持图像质量，要么无法适应下游处理变化，导致端到端感知质量次优。

Method: 提出 ControlGS，一个优化端到端视觉质量的 XR 高斯渲染管线：1）建模并将渲染输出与人眼之间的整个下游处理集成进优化目标；2）为适应运行时的下游处理，以该处理参数为条件动态生成高斯原语（Gaussian primitives）。

Result: 实验表明，ControlGS 在不同神经高斯主干（neural Gaussian backbones）和数据集上都能持续提升端到端后光学 XR 质量，且额外开销极小。代码已开源：https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/。

Conclusion: ControlGS 通过将下游处理纳入优化并条件化生成高斯原语，实现了对运行时变化的鲁棒端到端高质量 XR 渲染，验证了“面向感知终端”优化范式的有效性。

Abstract: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.

</details>


### [79] [Amnesia by Design, Memory By Necessity: Persistent State for Document Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32041)
*Souhail Bakkali,Ayoub Merimi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该综述指出Document AI存在“无状态瓶颈”：现有系统将文档处理视为无状态函数，跨文档、跨会话、跨时间不保留任何状态。作者提出以“持久化、证据锚定的文档状态”为统一框架，形式化其操作与不变量，并通过“状态性审计”揭示现有基准的缺陷，进而设计纵向基准与五项反事实指标来评估持久状态的收益、成本、风险与可治理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代Document AI能够读取合同、抽取字段、对表格推理并将答案定位到页面区域，但处理完即遗忘：第二天处理修订文件时从零开始，既不保留模式、也不检测矛盾、也不积累经验。作者强调这是结构性选择而非规模问题——当前系统本质上是无状态函数，即“无状态瓶颈”。该瓶颈无法仅靠参数扩展、上下文延长或检索增强来解决：存储提供持久性、检索提供访问，但两者都不能把观察结果固化为可改善未来处理的知识。

Method: 1) 将“持久化、证据锚定的文档状态”形式化为统一框架，规定把多模态证据转化为持久、可溯源状态所需的操作与不变量；2) 进行“状态性审计”，用八项状态性准则对十个代表性基准进行编码评估，发现跨会话状态演化未被测试；3) 据此推导出纵向基准测试框架（longitudinal benchmark harness），并设计五项反事实指标：Experience Gain（经验增益）、Cost Efficiency（成本效率）、Memory Harm（记忆危害）、Forgetting Fidelity（遗忘保真度）、Coverage Retention（覆盖保持度）。

Result: 状态性审计表明，十个代表性基准在八项状态性准则下均未覆盖跨会话的状态演化；作者据此给出纵向基准测试框架与五项反事实指标，用于刻画持久化文档状态的收益、成本、风险与可治理性。论文同时指出，Document AI目前缺乏将持久状态与文档原生结构、溯源信息及时间有效性相耦合的机制。

Conclusion: Document AI缺乏把持久状态与文档原生结构、溯源与时间有效性相耦合的机制。作者判断，Document AI的下一个时代将由系统在跨文档、跨会话与跨时间维度上“保留什么”来定义，即从无状态函数转向具备持久、可溯源、可治理状态的系统。

Abstract: Modern Document AI reads contracts, extracts fields, reasons over tables, and grounds answers to page regions, then forgets everything. Processing an amendment the next day begins from scratch: no schema retained, no contradiction detected, no experience carried forward. This is a structural choice, not a scale failure: current systems are stateless functions. We call this the statelessness bottleneck. This bottleneck lies beyond parameter scaling, context extension, and retrieval augmentation: storage provides persistence and retrieval provides access, but neither consolidates observations into knowledge that improves future processing. This survey formalizes persistent evidence-grounded document state as a unifying framework, specifying the operations and invariants required to convert multimodal evidence into durable, provenance-linked state. We introduce a statefulness audit showing that ten representative benchmarks, coded against eight statefulness criteria, leave cross-session state evolution untested, and derive a longitudinal benchmark harness with five counterfactual metrics: Experience Gain, Cost Efficiency, Memory Harm, Forgetting Fidelity, Coverage Retention, to characterize the benefit, cost, risk, and governability of persistent document state. Document AI lacks mechanisms coupling persistent state to document-native structure, provenance, and temporal validity. The next era of Document AI will be defined by what systems retain across documents, sessions, and time.

</details>


### [80] [ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32068)
*Jingxiang Qu,Lucie Taglienti,Evan Atherton*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ReFM：将动作重定向重构为"渐进式细化"任务，用能量引导的流模型，在无高质量配对数据下保持语义一致与物理合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作重定向依赖高质量配对数据监督，且常用"向复制动作回归"的方式保持语义，会把有用关节线索与骨架比例/体形不匹配产生的伪影纠缠在一起；同时单次前向回归一个唯一目标具有限制性，因为重定向本质上是欠定的，需要平衡语义保真度与目标角色特有的物理、时序约束。

Method: ReFM 为源网格无关（source-mesh-agnostic）的能量引导模型：1) 用 SO(3) 规范化器去除冗余全局朝向变化；2) 通过对比学习预训练跨角色语义编码器，得到角色不变表示，用于优化引导与语义评估；3) 以语义一致性、物理合理性、时序连贯性和最小动作修改为能量引导，用学习到的流（flow）对初始目标动作做渐进式细化。初始化策略可插拔，兼容直接复制动作与 Autodesk HumanIK 全身逆运动学重定向。

Result: 框架可适配不同的初始化方式（直接动作复制与 HumanIK 逆运动学重定向），通过对比学习获得角色不变语义表示，并以多重能量引导的流式渐进细化同时提升语义一致性与物理/时序合理性。

Conclusion: 动作重定向应被建模为欠定条件下的渐进式细化而非单次配对回归；以角色不变的语义表示为引导、结合物理与时序能量约束，可在缺乏高质量配对数据时实现语义保真与物理合理的跨骨架动作迁移。

Abstract: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

</details>


### [81] [Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32131)
*Tong Wu,Runze Cheng,Xiaoyue Fan,Kaan Akşit*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出在2D高斯表示参数（而非像素）中嵌入信息的隐写方法，用密钥选择子集微调嵌入8比特消息，正确密钥可无误差恢复，错误密钥BER接近随机猜测，视觉损失极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2D高斯图像表示日益流行，而现有隐写多在像素域进行；作者希望探索在高斯表示参数域中嵌入信息，以在保持重构图像高视觉保真度的同时实现可靠的消息隐藏与密钥控制。

Method: 先对目标图像拟合2D高斯表示参数，再用密钥选取部分参数进行微调以嵌入8比特消息。嵌入通过三类高斯参数实现：对数各向异性、不透明度与颜色亮度。对比随机选择与"最小扰动编辑"选择策略，并在112张256×256自然图像、4096个高斯上验证；另做九次拟合的简化设置，去掉颜色亮度，载荷仅用两类参数（减少33.3%），256个高斯全部保留。

Result: 三张合成图像30次拟合：正确密钥可无误差恢复消息，错误密钥BER为0.543（接近随机猜测）；相较随机选择，选择最小扰动编辑恢复更可靠（单侧p=0.031），平均PSNR代价仅0.091 dB。112张自然图像：正确密钥BER为0.000，错误密钥BER约0.520。简化设置中正确密钥仍无误差恢复，但错误密钥BER由0.514升至0.571，反而更偏离随机猜测（0.5）。

Conclusion: 在2D高斯表示参数中嵌入信息可行且视觉代价极低，密钥能有效区分正确与错误解码；选择最小扰动编辑优于随机选择；减少参数类型并不影响正确解码，但会削弱错误密钥下接近随机猜测的特性，提示参数类型数量对安全性表现有影响。

Abstract: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing. Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).

</details>


### [82] [CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32157)
*Narendiran Chembu,Navvrat Rao,Shreedhar Shreeshail Kodate,Gayatri Srujana Banda,Arko Sarkar,Abhinav Khanna,Rajarshee Das,Umesh Kanala,Siddarth Khandelwal,Kumar Aman,Aish Dubey,Kaustubh Beedkar,Arjun Jain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CausalDriveBench：基于 Pearl 因果层级（PCH）评估驾驶专用 VLA 的因果推理能力，包含 7,285 个因果 QA 对与 1,000 条反事实轨迹，揭示当前模型在因果理解上的系统性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型在自动驾驶中会输出自然语言推理与预测轨迹，但现有评测未检验这些推理是否真正反映场景的因果结构；模型可能依赖感知显著性而非因果相关性，流畅的解释与准确的观测场景轨迹不足以证明因果理解。

Method: 构建 CausalDriveBench 评测框架：以 Pearl 因果层级（PCH）为理论基础，在 nuScenes 上构建因果场景图，区分因果活跃、休眠与干扰实体，剥离感知显著性与因果相关性；QA 生成覆盖 PCH 四个层级（关联、干预、反事实与因果发现）；对高层级任务额外提供场景修改下的参考轨迹，实现动作层面的验证。数据规模为 7,285 个经校验的因果 QA 对与 1,000 条反事实轨迹。评测对象为 10 个驾驶专用 VLA 与 3 个通用 VLM。

Result: 三项发现：一，最佳模型 QA 准确率仅 70.6%，13 个模型中有 4 个低于随机水平；二，将各驾驶 VLA 与共享语言骨干的通用 VLM 对比，驾驶微调的因果 QA 代价为 2–34 个百分点，差异由后训练设计解释；三，因果 QA 与轨迹准确率在各模型间统计上不相关，反事实提示下预测轨迹要么过度反应、要么退化为观测场景基线。

Conclusion: 流畅的推理文本与准确的观测场景轨迹均不能作为因果理解的证据；当前驾驶 VLA 的因果推理能力仍显著不足，需针对因果结构而非感知显著性进行评测与训练改进。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

</details>


### [83] [PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.32162)
*Yu-Shan Tai,Amber Yijia Zheng,Raymond A. Yeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 PruneForget，将机器遗忘与模型剪枝联合求解，用遗忘集指导剪枝，使两者相互受益，在图像分类器与生成模型上以极低性能损失实现遗忘且模型更紧凑、推理成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中机器遗忘（出于安全等需求）与模型剪枝（满足延迟和内存预算）常需同时满足，但已有工作通常将二者独立处理，例如先遗忘后剪枝的顺序执行。作者认为二者本质对齐，应联合求解并相互感知。

Method: 提出 PruneForget：直觉上编码被遗忘样本信息的参数是天然剪枝目标，因为遗忘与剪枝都要求"删除"这些参数。该方法以遗忘集（unlearn set）作为剪枝的指导信号，从而让遗忘与剪枝互相促进。

Result: 在图像分类器和生成模型上的大量实验表明，PruneForget 能消除被遗忘样本的影响，同时生成更紧凑、推理成本更低的模型，其性能与"从头重训练以遗忘再剪枝"的 oracle 相比差距可忽略。

Conclusion: 遗忘与剪枝自然对齐，联合求解优于分别独立处理；PruneForget 以互益方式同时达成有效遗忘与高效压缩，接近 oracle 上界。

Abstract: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other.
