This raises a fundamental question: \emph{can the relative attack difficulty of different inputs be characterized before optimization begins?} In this paper, we investigate this question for person-vanishing attacks by introducing the concept of pre-optimization attack difficulty, which captures intrinsic differences in optimization effort across input images. To estimate this latent difficulty before optimization, we propose Quad-CLEVER, an efficient geometry-based estimator derived from a quadratic approximation of the local person-vanishing margin along the most attack-relevant direction. Extensive experiments across multiple attack algorithms demonstrate that Quad-CLEVER consistently correlates with the observed optimization cost, providing empirical evidence that attack difficulty exhibits a predictable pre-optimization structure. Building upon this finding, we further propose a difficulty-aware attack framework that leverages the estimated difficulty to adaptively allocate optimization budgets for a base attack under a fixed computational budget. On BDD100K, the proposed framework improves the image-level attack success rate by up to 5.78$\%$ while reducing the average optimization cost by up to 11.42 iterations. On the more challenging EventPed dataset, it saves 2.25 optimization iterations while maintaining comparable attack performance. These results demonstrate that attack difficulty can be meaningfully estimated before optimization and that exploiting such estimates enables more computationally efficient adversarial attacks.

</details>


### [319] [SubjectAnchor: Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video for Multi-Shot Storytelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34502)
*Xinyu Wang,Huafeng Shi,Zian Li,Yan Zhou,Xiaoqiang Liu,Yue Ma,Pengfei Wan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SubjectAnchor，一种主体感知的 memory-to-video 范式，通过从先前镜头提取显式视觉记忆来条件生成当前镜头，以在剪辑间保持主体身份与场景一致性，同时保留逐镜头提示的可控性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多镜头叙事视频生成中需在镜头切换间保持主体身份与场景一致性，同时不牺牲基于脚本的逐镜头可控性；现有 memory-based 与 holistic 基线在跨镜头身份一致性上不足。

Method: 基于 Wan2.2-I2V-A14B，包含三个组件：(1) 主体相关记忆构建：为每个目标镜头追溯各必需主体的历史出现，检索最相关的预计算关键帧形成紧凑 memory bank；(2) 主体感知时间旋转位置编码：将记忆帧作为显式视觉条件编码进模型输入，并将不同主体分配到分离的负时间槽以减少身份干扰；(3) memory-aware attention partition：在共享 backbone 内调控 memory token 与生成内容的交互。

Result: 在跨镜头身份一致性上优于代表性 memory-based 与 holistic 基线，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量。

Conclusion: SubjectAnchor 在保留显式视觉记忆外观锚定能力的同时，与脚本驱动的逐镜头生成兼容，验证了主体感知记忆条件生成范式的有效性。

Abstract: We present SubjectAnchor, a Subject-Aware Memory-to-Video paradigm for multi-shot storytelling in which the current shot is generated by conditioning on explicit visual memories extracted from previous shots. The objective is to preserve subject identity and scene consistency across cuts while retaining the controllability of shot-wise prompting. Built on Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, SubjectAnchor contains three key components: subject-related memory construction, subject-aware temporal rotary position encoding, and memory-aware attention partition. For each target shot, the method constructs a compact memory bank by tracing each required subject to its historical appearance and retrieving the most relevant precomputed keyframes. These memory frames are encoded into the model input as explicit visual conditions, while different subjects are assigned to separated negative temporal slots to reduce identity interference. In addition, memory-aware attention partition regulates the interaction between memory tokens and generated content within a shared backbone. This formulation preserves the appearance anchoring of explicit visual memory while remaining compatible with script-driven shot-by-shot generation. Experiments show that SubjectAnchor improves cross-shot identity consistency over representative memory-based and holistic baselines while maintaining competitive visual quality.

</details>


### [320] [XFlow: A Workflow Model for Instruction-Guided Lesion Segmentation in Chest X-rays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34513)
*Geon Choi,Hangyul Yoon,Hyunki Park,Sang Hoon Seo,Edward Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: XFlow：一种模拟放射科医生“由粗到细”感知流程的指令引导病灶分割模型，通过“框定位 + 多轮点细化”提升分割质量并保留可解释的中间决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有胸部X光（CXR）文本引导分割模型仅覆盖少量解剖结构与病灶，且大多假设查询目标必然存在。指令引导病灶分割（ILS）及首个模型ROSALIA虽能分割多样病灶并识别缺失病灶，但其掩码质量有限、常含散乱噪声，且单次预测方式与放射科医生先整体扫查、再定位异常区域、最后精修轮廓的实际感知与勾画过程不符。

Method: 受“由粗到细、多层次”感知过程启发，提出工作流模型XFlow：先检测双侧肺，判断查询征象在各肺中是否存在；再以病灶框提示经微调的SAM生成初始掩码；随后通过点提示进行多轮细化，直至边界贴合病灶，并使所有中间决策可视化。

Result: 在内部与外部评估中，XFlow均取得最佳分割质量；即使在相同病灶标注上训练，其分割质量仍优于ROSALIA。

Conclusion: 将框式定位与多轮点细化相结合的“由粗到细”工作流能有效提升ILS的分割质量与可解释性，XFlow为指令引导病灶分割提供了新的思路，代码与模型权重将公开。

Abstract: Existing text-guided segmentation models in the medical domain cover only a narrow set of anatomical structures and lesions in chest X-rays (CXRs), and most of them assume that the queried target is always present in the image. Instruction-guided lesion segmentation (ILS) was introduced to overcome these limitations by segmenting diverse lesion types from simple user instructions while also recognizing when the queried lesion is absent, and ROSALIA was proposed as the first model for this task. However, the masks produced by ROSALIA remain of limited quality, often carrying scattered noise. Moreover, ROSALIA predicts the mask in a single shot, which differs fundamentally from how radiologists perceive and delineate lesions in practice. A radiologist first surveys the entire thorax, then localizes the approximate region of abnormality, and only then refines the lesion contour. Motivated by this coarse-to-fine, multi-level perception process, we present XFlow, a workflow model for ILS that combines box-based localization with multi-turn point refinement. XFlow detects the lungs, decides whether the queried finding is present in each of them, and prompts a fine-tuned SAM with the lesion box for an initial mask. It then corrects that mask through point prompts until its boundary follows the lesion, leaving every intermediate decision visible. Our experiments show that XFlow achieves the best segmentation quality on both internal and external evaluation. Notably, it surpasses ROSALIA in segmentation quality even when the two are trained on the same lesion annotations. Code and model weights will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [321] [Evidence Before Accuracy: A MRI-PET Fusion Network for Alzheimer Disease Classification with Causal Regional Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34520)
*Saeid Firouzi Daghigh,Saeed Ayat*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究提出融合T1 MRI与FDG PET三个切面的网络，在ADNI 554对受试者上取得AUC 0.962，但核心贡献是围绕该性能构建的"证据层"：通过捷径对照、标签置换、正反向ROI消融与归因方法比较，证明模型依赖AD相关的生物学特征（MRI海马体、PET后扣带/后DMN），而非数据集伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习AD分类模型常报告近乎完美的判别性能，但少有工作证明其依据是AD相关神经生物学，而非数据集伪影、受试者级泄漏或非脑影像内容。作者旨在为模型性能提供可验证的生物学证据。

Method: 构建融合T1 MRI与FDG PET、覆盖轴位/冠状位/矢状位的双模态网络，在ADNI 554对配对受试者上训练；先量化模态、切面与切片几何的影响（仅用验证集的切片中心与邻域间距搜索）；再构建证据层：捷径对照（剪影/外部/空白）、标签置换零假设、正向ROI消融（掩蔽MRI内侧颞叶皮层与PET后DMN）、反向ROI消融（保留单一区域）、以及归因方法定量比较（遮挡敏感度）。

Result: 融合模型AUC 0.962、准确率0.909、F1 0.891。切片几何搜索使MRI AUC变动0.180、PET变动0.078，MRI偏好窄间距、PET偏好宽间距，所选冠状位中心分别落在海马体与后扣带。捷径对照AUC降至0.622（剪影）、0.608（外部）、0.500（空白），标签置换零假设为0.456。正向消融中掩蔽MRI内侧颞叶皮层与PET后DMN对AD logit影响最大，面积匹配对照与零假设无差别。反向消融中仅内侧颞叶保留MRI高于随机判别力的89.2%，仅后DMN保留PET的79.0%。遮挡敏感度在AD先验区域内达3.5–5.0倍富集，对照区仅0.10–0.43倍。

Conclusion: 消融与归因两种独立方法一致建立了一个生物学上正确的双分离：海马体证据由MRI承载，后扣带证据由PET承载。这表明模型的高判别性能建立在AD相关神经生物学基础上，而非伪影或泄漏，同时以更低成本达到与近期3D CNN及多模态Transformer相当的水平。

Abstract: Deep learning models for Alzheimer disease (AD) classification routinely report near-perfect discrimination, yet few are shown to rest on AD-relevant neurobiology rather than on dataset artifacts, subject-level leakage, or non-brain image content. We present a fusion network combining T1 MRI and FDG PET across axial, coronal, and sagittal planes, trained on ADNI consists of 554 paired subjects. The fusion model reaches AUC 0.962, accuracy 0.909, and F1 0.891, competitive with recent 3D CNN and multimodal transformer systems at substantially lower cost. We first quantify how much modality, plane and slice geometry matter. A validation-only search over slice centres and neighbour spacings moves AUC by 0.180 for MRI and 0.078 for PET, selecting narrow spacing for MRI and wide spacing for PET, with the chosen coronal centres falling on the hippocampal body and on the posterior cingulate respectively. The contribution, however, is the evidence layer built around that number. Shortcut controls collapse the model to AUC 0.622 (silhouette), 0.608 (exterior), and 0.500 (blank), and a label-permutation null yields 0.456. Forward region-of-interest (ROI) ablation shows that masking medial temporal cortex in MRI and the posterior default-mode network (DMN) in PET produces the largest shift in the AD logit, while area-matched controls remain indistinguishable from that null. Reverse ROI ablation shows that the medial temporal lobe alone retains 89.2% of above-chance discrimination in MRI and the posterior DMN alone retains 79.0% in PET. A quantitative comparison of attribution methods shows occlusion sensitivity reaching 3.5-5.0* enrichment inside a priori AD regions against 0.10-0.43* in controls. Ablation and attribution independently establish a biologically correct double dissociation: hippocampal evidence is carried by MRI, posterior cingulate evidence by PET.

</details>


### [322] [SAGE: Subspace Alignment for Classifier-Free Guidance in Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34525)
*Boyu Zhang,Yangming Cheng,Ning Zhang,Pengfei Liu,Weijie Li,Yifan Gao,Hangyu Li,Litong Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文发现扩散Transformer与MoE路由结合时存在一个此前未报告的失效模式：CFG的两个分支独立路由，导致无条件激活漂移到条件子空间之外，并被CFG以引导尺度线性放大；作者提出训练期正则化器SAGE，将无条件MoE激活对齐到条件子空间，在不增加推理开销的前提下抑制极端漂移并提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer结合MoE路由是扩展生成模型的主流方案，而CFG对生成质量至关重要。但二者结合时，过高的引导尺度会引发崩溃。作者希望定位这一崩溃背后的机制性原因，并加以缓解。

Method: 作者将其诊断为：CFG的两个分支独立进行MoE路由，使各自实现的激活落在不同子空间；无条件写入因此偏离条件子空间，而CFG在引导尺度上线性放大该残差。为此提出SAGE——一种训练期正则化器，在不限制路由多样性的前提下，将无条件MoE激活对齐到条件子空间，且推理阶段零额外开销。

Result: 在玩具实验中，SAGE将极端漂移显著抑制了9.2倍；扩展到10亿参数的文本到图像模型后，显著提升生成质量，在DPG-Bench峰值性能上带来9.3%的提升。大量实验表明SAGE持续优于基线。

Conclusion: SAGE揭示了扩散Transformer与MoE+CFG组合中的子空间漂移失效模式，并提供了一个无需推理开销、可扩展至十亿级模型的训练期正则化方案，稳定提升生成质量。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing are a leading recipe for scaling generative models. Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is essential for generation quality, yet excessively high guidance scales trigger collapse. We identify a previously unreported failure mode in their combination: the two CFG branches route independently, so their realized activations occupy different subspaces. The unconditional write then leaves the conditional subspace, and CFG amplifies that residual linearly in the guidance scale. We propose SAGE, a training-time regularizer that aligns unconditional MoE activations to the conditional subspace without restricting routing diversity, at zero inference cost. Toy experiments show that SAGE dramatically suppresses extreme drift by 9.2x. When scaled to a 1B-parameter text-to-image model, SAGE significantly improves generation quality, delivering a 9.3% boost in peak DPG-Bench performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAGE consistently outperforms the baseline.

</details>


### [323] [RRG-SLAM: Real-time Reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM for Indoor Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34527)
*Yong Liu,Keyang Ye,Zhexi Peng,Ruixian Mei,Kun Zhou,Tianjia Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出首个面向室内场景的实时反射感知高斯SLAM系统，通过TSDF-高斯混合表示分离漫反射与反射成分，实现高质量重建、鲁棒跟踪与实时新视角渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内场景中的平面反射会干扰传统SLAM的几何重建与相机跟踪，现有系统难以实时、显式地处理反射成分，导致重建质量下降、跟踪漂移以及新视角渲染失真。作者因此希望构建一个能够显式分离漫反射与反射、并保持实时性的SLAM系统。

Method: 提出反射感知的TSDF-高斯混合表示：基础场景由TSDF体素与一组基础高斯建模，捕捉几何与漫反射外观；平面反射则由与检测到的反射平面关联的反射高斯组表示。渲染分三趟进行：1）TSDF光线投射得到表面颜色、深度、平面ID与反射掩码；2）基础高斯以顺序无关方式渲染并经深度剔除，与TSDF输出合成基础图像；3）在平面ID图引导下，不同反射组的高斯仅光栅化到对应平面区域生成反射图像，再经反射掩码与基础图像合成最终输出。在线重建中，先通过反射感知跟踪估计相机位姿以抑制反射主导区域的干扰，再利用几何、语义与时序线索识别反射平面，将观测融合进带反射感知属性的增强TSDF体素中；随后在线初始化、优化与剪枝基础高斯与反射高斯，兼顾质量与效率。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在含反射的室内环境中，于重建质量、跟踪鲁棒性与新视角渲染方面均优于现有SLAM系统，同时保持实时性能。

Conclusion: 该工作首次实现了实时反射感知的高斯SLAM系统，验证了显式分离漫反射与反射成分对提升室内SLAM重建、跟踪与渲染效果的有效性，并保持了实时运行能力。

Abstract: We introduce the first real-time reflection-aware Gaussian SLAM system for indoor scenes. The system features a reflection-aware TSDF-Gaussian hybrid representation that explicitly separates diffuse scene appearance from reflection components. The base scene is modeled by a TSDF volume and a set of base Gaussians capturing geometry and diffuse appearance, while planar reflections are represented by reflection Gaussian groups associated with detected reflective planes. The rendering is performed in three passes: TSDF raycasting first yields surface color, depth, plane IDs and reflection masks; base Gaussians are then rendered order-independently with depth culling and combined with the TSDF output to form the base image; finally, under the guidance of the plane ID map, reflection Gaussians from different reflection groups are rasterized only into their corresponding planar regions to generate the reflection image, which is subsequently composited with the base image via the reflection mask to produce the final output. For online reconstruction, our system first estimates the camera pose through reflection-aware tracking to suppress interference of reflection-dominated regions. It then identifies reflective planes using geometric, semantic, and temporal cues, and fuses the observations into the augmented TSDF volume with reflection-aware attributes. Afterwards the base and reflection Gaussians are initialized, optimized, and pruned online to maintain both reconstruction quality and efficiency. Experiments on a variety of datasets show that our method outperforms existing SLAM systems in reconstruction quality, tracking robustness, and novel-view rendering for indoor environments with reflections, while preserving real-time performance.

</details>


### [324] [Preference-Guided Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation via Prompt Disagreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34528)
*Hyun-Kurl Jang,Jihun Kim,Kuk-Jin Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出偏好引导的开放词汇语义分割域适应框架，利用提示模板歧义挖掘局部偏好监督，无需像素级标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）在通用基准上泛化性强，但在医学影像、遥感、工业检测等专业领域性能下降；这些领域获取稠密像素级掩码成本高且依赖专家知识，因此需要摆脱密集掩码监督的适应方法。

Method: 观察到同一图像在不同提示模板下产生系统性不同的分割结果，即"提示歧义"，将其作为内置偏好监督来源。据此从跨模板高不确定性区域挖掘局部化偏好查询，采用区域局部化偏好优化（RLPO）结合一致性正则化（稳定查询区域外的更新）来适应OVSS模型。

Result: 在MESS基准上的大量实验中，该方法在多种OVSS骨干网络上取得一致提升，且完全无需像素级标注；在偏好存在噪声时仍保持有效。

Conclusion: 提示歧义可被有效转化为偏好监督信号，为专业领域OVSS适应提供了一条无需密集掩码、对噪声鲁棒的可行路径，代码已开源。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) enables pixel-level prediction over arbitrary text-specified vocabularies and has shown strong generalization on common benchmarks. However, OVSS performance often degrades in specialized domains such as medical imaging, remote sensing, and industrial inspection, where dense pixel-level masks for adaptation are costly to obtain and require domain-specific expertise. We propose a preference-guided adaptation framework that replaces dense mask supervision with binary preferences. We observe that different prompt templates produce systematically different segmentations for the same image, a phenomenon we call prompt disagreement, and we repurpose it as a built-in source of preference supervision. Building on this, we mine localized preference queries from regions of high cross-template uncertainty, and adapt the OVSS model with Region-Localized Preference Optimization (RLPO) together with consistency regularization that stabilizes updates outside the queried region. Across extensive experiments on the MESS benchmark, the proposed method achieves consistent gains across diverse OVSS backbones without any pixel-level annotation, and remains effective under noisy preferences. Our code is available at https://github.com/blue-531/pref-ovss.

</details>


### [325] [TSGate: Timestep-Aware Gated Attention for Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34539)
*Boyu Zhang,Yifan Liu,Shuxia Lin,Qingjian Ni,Yinfei Xu,Xu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对扩散Transformer（DiT）在域外提示下生成质量下降的问题，作者发现其与注意力汇聚及早期去噪步的图像-文本注意力减弱相关，提出时间步感知门控注意力（TSGate），通过时间步条件偏置调节门控信号，使门控行为随去噪步自适应，在多个基准上超过基线，原始提示DPG得分提升9.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT已成为高保真图像与视频生成的主流架构，且训练中越来越多地使用结构化提示以提升描述质量与提示遵循度。但面对域外（OOD）提示（如推理时用户输入的自由形式描述），生成质量会显著下降。基于LLM的重写虽可将提示转为结构化格式，却无法保证重写后的提示与训练分布对齐，因此需要从模型内部机制层面解决该退化问题。

Method: 作者首先进行机理分析，将OOD提示下的质量退化归因于注意力汇聚（attention sinks）以及早期去噪步图像-文本注意力的减弱，并指出仅抑制汇聚不足以恢复生成质量：即使有效抑制汇聚，使用标准门控注意力的模型早期图像-文本注意力仍然降低、生成质量仍不理想。基于此提出Timestep-Aware Gated Attention（TSGate），在门控信号中注入时间步条件偏置，使门控行为在去噪过程中动态自适应。

Result: 大量实验表明，TSGate在多个基准上一致优于基线模型与标准门控注意力，在原始提示（raw-prompt）设置下DPG得分较基线提升9.5%。

Conclusion: OOD提示导致的DiT生成质量退化与注意力汇聚及早期图像-文本注意力不足密切相关，单纯抑制汇聚并不充分；引入时间步条件的门控偏置（TSGate）可有效恢复并提升生成质量，验证了让门控机制随去噪步自适应的有效性。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have emerged as the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image and video generation. Recent DiT systems increasingly use structured prompts for training, improving caption quality and prompt adherence. However, their generation quality can degrade severely under out-of-domain (OOD) prompts, including the free-form descriptions supplied by users at inference time. Although LLM-based rewriting can convert these prompts into structured formats, it does not guarantee that the rewritten prompts align with the training distribution. Our analysis links this degradation to attention sinks and reduced early-step image-to-text attention and shows that sink suppression alone is insufficient to restore generation quality. Despite effective sink suppression, models trained with standard gated attention exhibit reduced early-step image-to-text attention and suboptimal generation quality. Based on these insights, we propose Timestep-Aware Gated Attention (TSGate), which injects a timestep-conditioned bias into the gate signal so that gating behavior adapts across denoising steps. Extensive experiments show that TSGate consistently outperforms both the baseline and standard gated attention across multiple benchmarks, improving the raw-prompt DPG score by 9.5% over the baseline.

</details>


### [326] [ActionLens: Diagnosing Spatial-Temporal Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34547)
*Gueter Josmy Faure,Min-Hung Chen,Hao Ping Wang,Timothée Lardy,Hung-Ting Su,Winston H. Hsu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 ActionLens，一个包含 6,701 道视频多选题的诊断基准，覆盖五种时空绑定能力，揭示现有 VLM 在动作-人物-时刻绑定上的系统性失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频视觉语言模型在主流基准上得分超 80%，但在时空绑定（将正确动作与正确人物、正确时刻关联）上表现薄弱。现有基准缺乏针对该失败模式的细粒度诊断，无法区分不同模型族与规模的具体缺陷。

Method: 构建 ActionLens 基准：6,701 道多选题，覆盖 transition detection、actor-specific identification、concurrent action binding、directed interaction reasoning、gaze detection 五类诊断。真值由 1.58M 每秒、每人标注确定性推导。经 14 轮人工质量工程将答案清晰度从 53% 提升至 90% 以上。评估 20 个 VLM，并设置参考接口对照（关系描述 vs 静态坐标 vs 视觉框）及 binding-trap 分析。

Result: 全集中最高模型得 68.8%；人工审核子集上为 65.9%，而人类参考为 91.0%。gaze detection 接近随机水平（人类 89.6%）。演员消歧中，关系描述比静态坐标高 5.55–13.25 分，证实数值解析惩罚；视觉框仍领先所有模型 1.15–6.50 分，暴露未框定演员解析残余差距。绑定陷阱分析显示模型系统性地选择了错误演员的动作。

Conclusion: ActionLens 提供跨模型族与规模的细粒度诊断测量，可对时空绑定的不同失败模式进行直接比较。数据、代码与评测脚本已开源。

Abstract: Video-capable vision-language models score above 80\% on popular benchmarks yet struggle with spatial-temporal binding: associating the right action with the right person at the right moment. We introduce ActionLens, a diagnostic benchmark of 6,701 multiple-choice video questions spanning five targeted diagnostics: transition detection, actor-specific identification, concurrent action binding, directed interaction reasoning, and gaze detection. Ground-truth answers are derived deterministically from 1.58 million per-second, per-person annotations. Fourteen rounds of human quality engineering raised answer clarity from 53% to above 90% human accuracy. Across 20 VLMs, the full-set leader scores 68.8%; on the human-reviewed subset, it scores 65.9% versus 91.0% for the pooled human reference. Gaze detection remains near chance against 89.6% human accuracy. On actor disambiguation, reference-interface controls show that relational descriptions recover 5.55--13.25 points over static coordinates, confirming a substantial numeric-parsing penalty; yet visual boxes still lead every model by 1.15--6.50 points, exposing a residual unboxed actor-resolution gap. A binding-trap analysis shows models systematically select the wrong actor's action. ActionLens provides diagnostic measurements of these distinct failure modes across model families and scales for direct comparison. We release all data, code, and evaluation scripts at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lmms-eval-2276

</details>


### [327] [ACPruner: Visual Token Pruning as Biased Attention Coverage Maximization in LVLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34558)
*Xu Li,Yuxuan Liang,Yi Zheng,Zhe Liu,Xiaolei Chen,Haotian Chen,Rui Zhu,Fan Shi,Xiangyang Xue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ACPruner，一个免训练的视觉 token 剪枝框架，将剪枝建模为“有偏注意力覆盖最大化”问题，在多个 LVLM 骨干上实现性能保持与显著推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM 因视觉 token 数量庞大而计算效率低下；现有剪枝方法多聚焦于“保留重要 token”或“选择多样 token”，未从覆盖角度统一考虑 token 对图像的整体覆盖与信息优先性。

Method: 将视觉 token 剪枝重构为有偏注意力覆盖最大化问题：1) 结合模态内显著性与模态间相关性估计 token 重要性；2) 由视觉编码器内部注意力模式推导 token 级覆盖度；3) 通过贪心选择最大化所提覆盖目标。框架免训练。

Result: 在 LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B、LLaVA-NeXT-7B/13B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B 等骨干上，ACPruner 持续保持较强性能，并带来显著的端到端推理加速。

Conclusion: 从覆盖视角统一重要性与多样性，ACPruner 为 LVLM 高效推理提供了免训练、通用性强的视觉 token 剪枝方案。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) face significant computational inefficiencies caused by the large number of visual tokens. Existing visual token pruning methods mainly focus on either retaining individually important tokens or selecting mutually diverse ones. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from a coverage perspective and formulate it as a biased attention coverage maximization problem. The key idea is to select a compact token subset whose encoder-side outgoing attention can jointly cover the image while assigning higher coverage priority to more informative regions. From this perspective, we propose ACPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient LVLM inference. ACPruner first estimates token importance by combining intra-modal saliency and inter-modal relevance, then derives token-wise coverage from attention patterns within the vision encoder, and finally performs greedy selection to maximize the proposed coverage objective. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLM backbones, including LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B, LLaVA-NeXT-7B/13B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and LLaVA-OneVision-7B, show that ACPruner consistently achieves strong performance retention while delivering substantial end-to-end inference speedups.

</details>


### [328] [Rethinking Latent Visual Reasoning: Grounding Latent Reasoning in Visual Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34563)
*Xi Xiao,Tianchen Zhao,Youngeun Kim,Zhuowei Li,Linghan Xu,Jiaye Wu,Zheng Zhang,Xiang Xu,Xuanbai Chen,Farhan Tejani,Jakub Zablocki,Julia Xu,Yifan Xing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文分析潜空间视觉推理（LVR）中潜token行为，发现"潜证据-信用差距"：潜token对改变正确答案的图像扰动响应微弱，源于GRPO训练缺乏显式监督。提出ReaLVR，利用正确/错误答案对比与匹配/不匹配视觉证据，为模型自身潜轨迹提供视觉证据监督，在多个模型家族上超越现有LVR基线，并首次将潜空间视觉推理扩展至235B规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVR让多模态大模型在连续潜token中完成中间计算，而非逐词输出推理步骤，但潜推理不可直接观测，难以监督潜token学到了什么。作者通过分析发现潜token对影响正确答案的图像扰动响应很弱，即"潜证据-信用差距"，并推测其源于GRPO训练中缺少显式监督：仅靠最终答案奖励，无法指导模型保留哪些视觉证据、如何在潜token间分配信用。

Method: 提出ReaLVR，将视觉证据监督引入模型自身的自由运行（free-running）潜轨迹。方法包含两部分：一是对比正确答案与模型生成的错误答案，确定何处需要更强监督；二是对比相关视觉证据与不匹配视觉证据，明确应当保留什么内容。

Result: 在三个模型家族上，ReaLVR持续优于所评估的LVR基线，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上取得五项任务平均63.7%的最高成绩。首次实现潜空间视觉推理的规模化，在最高235B的前沿模型规模下仍带来稳定提升。进一步分析显示：潜token位置对问题更敏感、与相关视觉区域的对齐更强，且最受关注的潜token对固定上下文的依赖更大。

Conclusion: 最终答案奖励对潜推理的指导不足，是限制LVR的关键瓶颈；通过把视觉证据监督施加到模型自身潜轨迹上的ReaLVR能有效弥补潜证据-信用差距，并在多模型家族、多任务及大规模模型上取得一致提升，验证了潜空间视觉推理的可扩展性。

Abstract: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform intermediate computation in continuous latent tokens rather than expressing every reasoning step in words. However, unlike textual CoT, latent reasoning is not directly observable, making it difficult to supervise what latent tokens learn. In this work, we first conduct a thorough analysis of latent-token behavior and identify a latent evidence-credit gap: latent tokens respond only weakly to image perturbations that alter the correct answer. We hypothesize that this issue stems from the lack of explicit supervision during GRPO training. These findings suggest that a final-answer reward provides too little guidance on what visual evidence to preserve or how credit should be assigned across latent tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose ReaLVR, which brings visual-evidence supervision to the model's own free-running latent trajectories. ReaLVR contrasts correct and model-generated wrong answers to determine where stronger supervision is needed, and relevant and mismatched visual evidence to specify what to preserve. Across three model families, ReaLVR consistently outperforms evaluated LVR baselines, achieving the highest five-task average of 63.7% on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Crucially, we are the first to scale visual reasoning in latent space, showing that our framework continues to deliver robust improvements at frontier model scales up to 235B. Further analyses show more question-sensitive latent-token positions, stronger alignment with relevant visual regions, and greater fixed-context dependence on the most attended latent tokens.

</details>


### [329] [GLF-Q: Global-Local Feature-based Quantization for Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34564)
*Peilin Sun,Guang Liang,Jin Tong,Jianxin Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GLF-Q：一种基于全局-局部特征对齐的训练后量化框架，用于低比特Vision Transformer压缩，在3比特下超越现有方法并具备鲁棒性与部署加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特PTQ下ViT精度严重下降。现有基于优化的PTQ用软logits或二阶Hessian代理引导块重建：logits监督在有限校准数据上易过拟合，Hessian近似带来结构性截断误差。

Method: 提出GLF-Q框架，通过全局-局部特征对齐引导量化。将量化块输出经下游全精度层传播，在局部输出正则下对齐倒数第二层表示，实现无需显式Hessian近似或Taylor展开的下游特征监督；引入离线Hadamard变换以零运行时开销分散激活离群值、收缩动态范围；用STE优化损失实现快速收敛，绕过AdaRound类连续松弛取整。

Result: 在代表性ViT架构与图像分类任务上，GLF-Q搭配标准均匀量化器在3比特量化下显著优于SOTA；具备强域外校准鲁棒性，并在8比特GPU部署下实现加速。

Conclusion: GLF-Q以全局-局部特征对齐替代logits与Hessian代理监督，结合Hadamard变换和STE优化，有效缓解低比特PTQ精度退化，兼顾鲁棒性与实际部署效率。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) efficiently compresses Vision Transformers (ViTs) without retraining, yet suffers severe accuracy degradation at low bit-widths. Existing optimization-based PTQ methods guide block reconstruction via either soft logits or second-order Hessian proxies. Logit supervision is prone to overfitting on limited calibration data, while Hessian approximations incur structural truncation errors. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{GLF-Q}, a novel PTQ framework guided by Global-Local Feature alignment. GLF-Q propagates quantized block outputs through downstream full-precision layers to align penultimate-layer representations under local output regularization, providing downstream feature supervision without explicitly approximating the Hessian or using a Taylor expansion. Furthermore, offline Hadamard transformations are introduced with zero runtime overhead to disperse activation outliers across channels, effectively contracting dynamic ranges and reducing quantization errors. Meanwhile, optimizing this loss via a Straight-Through Estimator (STE) achieves rapid convergence, bypassing continuous relaxation rounding formulations such as AdaRound. Extensive experiments across representative ViT architectures demonstrate that GLF-Q with standard uniform quantizers substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods under 3-bit quantization on image classification. In addition, GLF-Q exhibits strong out-of-domain calibration robustness and achieves speedups under 8-bit GPU deployment.

</details>


### [330] [Recent Advances in Agentic Agri-Robotic Phenotyping: A Perspective Review from Fragmented Multimodal Sensing to Unified PhenoAgent Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34567)
*Muhammad Owais,Ehtesham Iqbal,Samee Ullah Khan,Muhammad Umraiz,Yusra Abdulrahman,Irfan Hussain*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该综述梳理植物表型从人工测量到高通量、机器人及AI驱动监测的演进，提出将表型重构为“种子-土壤-植株-环境-管理”（SSPEM）智能问题，并给出PhenoAgent概念框架，推动从孤立性状估计走向可解释、可扩展、面向部署的作物智能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表型系统在传感模态、作物性状、生长阶段、环境与管理目标之间高度碎片化，缺乏时间整合、多模态推理、生物学解释与可执行决策支持。

Method: 文献综述与概念框架构建：综合传统、高通量、机器人及AI驱动表型方法，将其统一到SSPEM交互视角，并提出集成多模态表型与智能体的PhenoAgent框架。

Result: 归纳各类表型技术的能力与持续局限，提出PhenoAgent可实现基于证据的作物状态解释、不确定性感知推理与管理导向支持，覆盖“发生了什么、为何发生、缺失何种证据、应采取何种行动或补充测量”等层次化洞见。

Conclusion: 通过连接多模态表型、智能体AI与闭环决策支持，可通向可解释、可扩展、面向部署的作物智能；但仍需应对数据稀缺、标注、基准测试、模型泛化与可解释性等挑战。

Abstract: This review examines the evolution of plant phenotyping from conventional manual trait measurement to high-throughput, robotic, and artificial intelligence-driven crop monitoring. Despite significant advances in imaging, autonomous platforms, multimodal sensing, and deep learning, current phenotyping systems remain fragmented across sensing modalities, crop traits, growth stages, environments, and management objectives. We therefore frame phenotyping as an integrated \emph{seed-soil-plant-environment-management} (SSPEM) intelligence problem, where crop performance reflects interactions among seed quality, root-zone conditions, plant development, environmental exposure, and management actions. The review synthesizes conventional, high-throughput, robotic, and AI-driven phenotyping approaches, highlighting their capabilities and persistent limitations in temporal integration, multimodal reasoning, biological interpretation, and actionable decision support. Building on this analysis, we introduce a conceptual PhenoAgent framework that extends phenotyping beyond the estimation of isolated traits to evidence-based crop-state interpretation, uncertainty-aware reasoning, and management-oriented support. The PhenoAgent concept primarily brings together scattered advances in phenotyping to deliver insights ranging from detailed to high-level, such as what is happening in the crop, why it might be occurring, what evidence is missing, and what actions or additional measurements should be considered. We also discuss challenges in dataset scarcity, annotation, benchmarking, model generalization, and explainability. By linking multimodal phenotyping with agentic AI and closed-loop decision support, this review outlines a path to interpretable, scalable, and deployment-oriented crop intelligence.

</details>


### [331] [GenNVS: Geometry-enhanced Novel View Synthesis via Disentangled 3D Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34579)
*Yajiao Xiong,Youyu Luan,Xiaoyu Zhou,Yongtao Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GenNVS：利用解耦3D先验（前背景分别用3DGS建模、由粗到细几何对齐）构建统一3D场景，并经由双流掩码机制条件化视频扩散模型，提升单图像新视角合成的几何结构与空间一致性，并支持场景编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图像新视角合成的核心困难在于底层3D几何高度歧义；现有扩散类方法虽能生成逼真结果，但难以保持前景物体的几何结构与空间一致性。

Method: 提出GenNVS框架：1）以前景物体和背景解耦的3D先验建模，二者均采用3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）表示；2）通过由粗到细（coarse-to-fine）的几何优化将两者对齐，形成统一3D场景；3）以该场景条件化视频扩散模型，采用Dual-Stream Masking机制，联合利用渲染有效性掩码（rendered validity masks）与几何感知变形（geometry-aware warping）引导合成。

Result: 实验表明，GenNVS在视觉质量与几何精度上均优于近期方法，并能自然支持灵活的场景编辑。

Conclusion: 通过解耦3D先验与几何增强的条件机制，可有效缓解单图新视角合成的几何歧义，兼顾生成质量与几何准确性，并拓展至可编辑的场景应用。

Abstract: Single-image novel view synthesis remains challenging because the underlying 3D geometry is highly ambiguous. Recent diffusion-based approaches produce plausible results, but they often struggle to preserve the geometric structure and spatial coherence of foreground objects. We present GenNVS, a framework for geometry-enhanced novel view synthesis via a disentangled 3D prior. Specifically, GenNVS models foreground objects and the background with 3D Gaussian Splatting and aligns them through a coarse-to-fine geometric optimization process to form a unified 3D scene. This scene conditions a video diffusion model through the proposed Dual-Stream Masking mechanism, which guides synthesis by jointly exploiting rendered validity masks and geometry-aware warping. Experimental results show that GenNVS performs favorably against recent methods in both visual quality and geometric accuracy, while naturally supporting flexible scene editing.

</details>


### [332] [Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation for Temporal Video Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34581)
*Shaobo Ju,Haiyang Yu,Xuecheng Wu,Qiong Wu,Jiacong Wang,Fan Shi,Peng Jun,Yiyi Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出反事实注意力策略蒸馏（CAPD），从在线策略蒸馏（OPD）视角解决MLLM时序视频定位中重复动作与视觉相似上下文带来的困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序视频定位是多模态大模型理解视频事件的关键能力，但在长视频中常受重复动作与视觉相似上下文限制。OPD虽能对学生生成轨迹提供密集教师监督，但基于下一token的师生蒸馏难以识别支撑每个预测时间戳的具体视频片段，而这正是时序定位的关键。

Method: CAPD度量掩蔽每个时序组如何改变教师的输出分布，由此得到的反事实影响用于校准教师注意力并对token级蒸馏加权，使学生学到影响边界预测的时序证据。训练设置在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上，仅用2500个样本训练一个epoch。

Result: 在TimeLens及多个通用视频基准上评估，CAPD相对GRPO在TimeLens上平均召回率提升12.0%，同时保持通用视频理解能力，达到与基座模型相当的准确率。

Conclusion: CAPD通过反事实影响校准教师注意力并加权token级蒸馏，有效提升MLLM的时序视频定位能力，且不损害通用视频理解性能。

Abstract: Temporal video grounding is a key capability of advanced \emph{Multimodal Large Language Models} (MLLMs) for the thorough understanding of video events, which is however often limited by repeated actions and visually similar contexts in long videos. In this paper, we study this issue from the perspective of \emph{On-policy distillation} (OPD) and propose a new training regime for MLLMs termed \emph{Counterfactual Attention Policy Distillation} (CAPD). In particular, OPD is a viable solution for MLLMs via providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. But its next-token based teacher-student distillation is hard to identify the specific video segments supporting each predicted timestamp, which is critical for temporal grounding. In this case, CAPD measures how masking each temporal group changes the teacher's output distribution. The resulting counterfactual influence calibrates the teacher's attention and weights token-level distillation, allowing the student to learn the temporal evidence that affects boundary prediction. To validate CAPD, we trained it on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct using only 2,500 samples for one epoch, and evaluated it on the TimeLens and multiple general video benchmarks. Experimental results show that CAPD improves average recall by 12.0\% relative to GRPO on TimeLens while preserving general video understanding, achieving comparable accuracy to the base model.

</details>


### [333] [Reinforcement Learning from Intermediate Renders for Image-to-Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34587)
*Omri Kaduri,Kate Feingold,Phillip Isola,Tali Dekel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出IR4RL，一种面向图像到代码生成（如Image-to-SVG、Image-to-TikZ）的强化学习框架，利用可执行中间代码前缀产生的部分渲染结果，构造token级的"渲染进度奖励"，为生成序列提供更密集的过程监督，在两项任务上超越监督微调与标准GRPO，刷新开源模型最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅依赖最终渲染输出计算单一终端奖励，反馈稀疏，无法对齐各个token的实际贡献：一段生成程序可能既包含准确复现目标局部的内容，也包含引入错误的操作，但所有token却共享同一最终结果进行训练。作者观察到大量中间代码前缀不仅可执行，而且已能产生有意义的部分渲染，可反映向目标的渐进进展，因此这为生成过程提供了天然的密集监督来源。

Method: 提出IR4RL框架：在图像到代码生成任务中，对生成过程中的中间代码前缀进行执行并渲染，将相邻中间渲染之间的变化转化为针对生成序列的局部（token级）反馈，构建token-level的render-progress奖励（渲染进度奖励），并以此奖励替代或补充单一终端奖励进行强化学习后训练。在Image-to-SVG与Image-to-TikZ两项任务上进行评测，与监督微调（SFT）及标准GRPO对比。

Result: 在Image-to-SVG和Image-to-TikZ两个任务上，IR4RL均优于监督微调与标准GRPO，取得了新的开源模型最优（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: 中间渲染是一种简单而有效的过程监督来源，可为图像到代码模型的强化学习后训练提供密集、token级的奖励信号；IR4RL证明了该思路的有效性，并推动该方向开源模型性能达到新的最优水平。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning is increasingly used to post-train vision-language models for image-to-code generation, such as generating SVG code from a reference image, by optimizing rewards computed from the final rendered output. However, relying on a single terminal reward provides sparse feedback that is poorly aligned with the contribution of individual tokens. A generated program may contain operations that accurately reproduce some parts of the target image alongside others that introduce errors, yet all tokens are trained from the same final outcome. We observe that many intermediate code prefixes are not only executable, but already produce meaningful partial renders that reflect progress toward the target. This property provides a natural source of denser supervision during generation. Based on this observation, we introduce IR4RL, an RL framework with a token-level render-progress reward that turns changes between intermediate renders into localized feedback for the generated sequence. We evaluate our approach on Image-to-SVG and Image-to-TikZ generation. Across both tasks, our method improves over supervised fine-tuning and standard GRPO, yielding new state-of-the-art open-source models. This shows that intermediate rendering provides a simple and effective source of process supervision for RL post-training of image-to-code models.

</details>


### [334] [Temporal Modelling for Burn Scars on Sentinel-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34596)
*Luca Barco,Edoardo Arnaudo,Andrea Bragagnolo,Claudio Rossi,Paolo Garza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建了包含246次野火事件的Sentinel-3 OLCI时序配对数据集，并系统基准测试了U-Net、SegFormer、ConvNeXt-UPerNet的空间与时序变体，发现引入火前影像的时序建模才能提升烧痕分割，且5波段子集即可媲美完整21波段配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 火烧痕快速精确制图对灾后损失评估至关重要。Sentinel-3 OLCI具备日重访与21个光谱波段，适合快速制图，但现有流程多将各期影像独立处理，未利用火前/火后变化信号。

Method: 基于Copernicus应急管理服务，构建2016-2025年246次野火事件、Sentinel-3 OLCI时序配对影像数据集；在两种输入模式与多种光谱配置下，基准测试三种骨干网络（U-Net、SegFormer、ConvNeXt-UPerNet）的空间及ConvLSTM增强的时序变体。

Result: 时序建模仅在包含火前影像时提升分割性能；5波段子集即可达到与完整21波段OLCI配置相当的效果。

Conclusion: 利用火前影像的时序变化信号可有效提升烧痕分割，且可通过波段精简降低数据需求，为快速火烧痕制图提供高效方案。

Abstract: Rapid and accurate burn scar delineation from satellite imagery is essential for post-fire damage assessment. Sentinel-3 OLCI, with daily revisit and 21 spectral bands, suits rapid mapping, yet most pipelines treat acquisitions independently, leaving the pre/post-fire change signal unexploited. We present a dataset of 246 wildfire activations (2016-2025) from the Copernicus Emergency Management Service, with Sentinel-3 OLCI temporally paired acquisitions. We benchmark spatial and temporal (ConvLSTM-augmented) variants of three backbones (U-Net, SegFormer, ConvNeXt-UPerNet) under two input modes and spectral configurations. Temporal modeling improves segmentation only when pre-fire frames are included, and a 5-band subset matches the full 21-band OLCI configuration.

</details>


### [335] [Summarize Before Grounding: Query-Guided Chunk Condensation for Long-Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34598)
*Nanxing Hu,Xiaoyue Duan,Qiwei Yan,Kailin Lyu,Jinchao Zhang,Guoliang Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"先摘要后定位"框架SumGround，通过查询引导的块级压缩与关联摘要检索，在RLVR下实现长视频时序定位，兼顾稀疏采样效率与关键证据保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频含大量冗余信息，干扰LVLM挖掘与查询相关的证据。稠密采样训练显存开销过大，而以RLVR为代表的稀疏采样虽训练可行，却可能遗漏关键证据。因此需要一种在稀疏采样下仍能聚合检索查询相关证据的方法。

Method: 将视频切分为若干chunk，进行两级块压缩：1）查询引导的隐式摘要，以查询引导提示的KV状态表示，将冗余视觉token压缩为紧凑的、与查询相关的块摘要；2）关联式摘要检索，对块摘要排序并选出最可能包含事件区间的块。两者均由RLVR驱动。此外提出长度感知梯度门控模块，选择性阻断回传至视觉token的梯度以降低显存。

Result: 在多个下游数据集上，SumGround优于先前SOTA方法，且长视频上提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 通过查询引导的块压缩与关联检索，并配合梯度门控，SumGround在RLVR范式下有效平衡了训练可行性、显存开销与长视频证据保留，成为长视频时序定位的有效方案。

Abstract: Video temporal grounding (VTG) aims to localize the video interval corresponding to a language query. Recent large vision-language models (LVLMs) show great potential in solving such a multi-modal reasoning task. However, long videos often contain large amounts of redundant information that disturbs LVLMs to mine query-relevant evidence. Instead of dense frame sampling which incurs prohibitive training memory, previous reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) works typically utilize sparse sampling, which makes training feasible but may miss critical evidence. In this paper, we propose a ``summarize before grounding'' framework (named ``SumGround'') for long-video temporal grounding. The key of SumGround is to perform query-guided chunk condensation to aggregate and retrieve query-relevant evidence. Specifically, we split the video into several chunks and perform two-level chunk condensation. First, we introduce query-guided latent summaries, which is represented as KV states of query-guided prompts, to compress redundant visual tokens into compact query-relevant chunk summaries. Furthermore, we design an associative summary retrieval scheme to rank and select chunk summaries that are most likely to contain the event interval. Both query-guided latent summary and associative summary retrieval schemes are enabled by RLVR. To reduce memory consumption, we propose a length-aware gradient gating module to selectively stop gradient back-propagated to visual tokens. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SumGround performs favorably against previous state-of-the-art methods across multiple downstream datasets, with remarkable gains on long videos.

</details>


### [336] [WorldAttention: An Efficient Attention Architecture for Interactive Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34606)
*Zeyu Zhang,Jinyuan Mao,Dakai An,Wangbo Zhao,Hanfeng Lu,Jiasheng Tang,Yinghao Yu,Wei Wang,Bohan Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出WorldAttention，一种系统级注意力架构，通过混合稀疏注意力（HSA）与分层KV缓存（HKV）的协同设计，解决交互式视频世界模型中长历史上下文与计算/显存开销的矛盾，并在VBench-Long与InterVBench上取得最优表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本条件交互式视频世界模型需要低延迟、长时程生成，但现有框架依赖滑动窗口来限制计算复杂度，牺牲了历史上下文，削弱长程交互能力；而保留完整历史缓存又因注意力二次复杂度和KV缓存线性增长导致算力开销过大与显存饱和。

Method: 提出WorldAttention系统级注意力架构，核心包括：1）混合稀疏注意力（HSA），以线性全局注意力为主，辅以头自适应稀疏注意力；2）分层KV缓存（HKV），将历史KV对组织为多级内存中的语义索引页，实现细粒度检索与可控的GPU驻留；并配套定制内核以将理论效率转化为实际性能。

Result: 在VBench-Long和InterVBench上的大量实验表明，WorldAttention持续超越此前最优方法，主体一致性得分分别达到0.9472（VBench-Long）和0.9668（InterVBench）。

Conclusion: 通过注意力核与缓存管理的协同设计，WorldAttention在保持长程历史上下文的同时显著提升效率，验证了系统级协同优化在长时程交互式视频世界模型中的有效性。

Abstract: Leveraging the paradigm of autoregressive diffusion, text-conditioned interactive video world models aim to simulate temporally coherent environments guided by textual instructions. While enabling low-latency, long-duration generation is pivotal for embodied AI and simulation-based planning, current frameworks primarily rely on sliding-window mechanisms to bound computational complexity. However, this approach inherently sacrifices historical context, undermining the long-range interactive capabilities. Conversely, maintaining a full-history cache remains computationally prohibitive and memory-intensive: the quadratic complexity of attention leads to excessive computational overhead, while the linear growth of the KV cache inevitably leads to GPU memory saturation. To overcome these limitations, we propose WorldAttention, a system-oriented attention architecture that achieves high efficiency through the co-design of specialized attention kernels and hierarchical KV cache management. First, we introduce Hybrid Sparse Attention (HSA), which integrates linear global attention supplemented with head-adaptive sparse attention. Additionally, we design a Hierarchical KV Cache (HKV) that organizes historical KV pairs into semantically indexed pages across multi-tier memory, enabling fine-grained retrieval and controlled GPU residency. These two designs are supported by tailored kernels to effectively translate their theoretical efficiency into real-world performance. Extensive experiments on VBench-Long and InterVBench demonstrate that WorldAttention consistently surpasses prior state-of-the-art methods, achieving subject consistency scores of 0.9472 on VBench-Long and 0.9668 on InterVBench, respectively.

</details>


### [337] [Does Native 3D Texture Generation Necessarily Require 3D Assets for Training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34621)
*Jiangshan Wang,Zeqiang Lai,Jiayi Guo,Xin Yang,Xin Huang,Jiarui Chen,Ziheng Ouyang,Chunchao Guo,Xiangyu Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Tex-Zero提出无需3D资产的native 3D纹理生成框架，仅用高质量2D图像即可训练，生成高保真细粒度3D纹理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Native 3D纹理生成通常被认为依赖大规模高质量真实3D资产，而此类数据获取困难。作者观察到3D纹理训练的关键是高质量细粒度颜色信息，几何信息相对次要且可人工构建，因此希望摆脱对3D资产的依赖。

Method: 将高质量2D图像表示为3D空间中的平面，并通过patch级随机旋转与聚合构建复杂几何结构，从而把2D图像转化为3D训练样本。基于此数据训练Tex-Zero VAE，可高质量重建真实3D资产；再训练Tex-Zero DiT，条件多视图图像同样转为3D平面并由Tex-Zero VAE编码，以减小表示差距。

Result: 大量实验表明，Tex-Zero仅使用图像作为训练数据即可生成高保真、细粒度细节丰富的3D纹理，且Tex-Zero VAE在训练中从未见过真实3D资产的情况下仍能高质量重建。

Conclusion: 该工作证明native 3D纹理生成可完全脱离3D资产训练，为3D纹理生成的数据范式扩展提供了新视角。

Abstract: Native 3D texture generation synthesizes colors directly in 3D space for a given geometry, conditioned on multi-view reference images. It is generally believed that training such models requires large-scale, high-quality real 3D asset data, whose acquisition remains a long-standing and challenging problem. In this work, we propose Tex-Zero, demonstrating that a high-fidelity native 3D texture generation framework can be trained without 3D assets. Our key observation is that only high-quality and fine-grained color information is essential for 3D texture training, while the required geometric information is less critical and can be manually constructed rather than obtained from real 3D assets. This finding makes it possible to transform abundant, high-quality 2D images into effective training samples for 3D texture generation. Specifically, we convert high-quality 2D images into 3D training samples by representing each image as a plane in 3D space and applying patch-wise random rotations and aggregation to construct complex geometric structures. Using these constructed image data, we train the Tex-Zero VAE, which can reconstruct real 3D assets with high quality despite never observing them during training. Building upon the Tex-Zero VAE, we train the Tex-Zero DiT also exclusively on the constructed image data, where the conditioning 2D multi-view images are transformed into planes in 3D space and also encoded by the Tex-Zero VAE, thereby reducing the representation gap and improving generation quality. Extensive experiments show that Tex-Zero generates high-fidelity 3D textures with fine-grained details solely using images as training data, offering a promising perspective on the data paradigm for scaling 3D texture generation.

</details>


### [338] [BMND: Direct Poisson Denoising by N-Dimensional Block Matching and Collaborative Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34622)
*Christof Duhme,Lars Schiefelbein,Florian Büther,Xiaoyi Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BMND框架，将BM3D/BM4D的块匹配与协同滤波推广到任意维度，直接处理高斯与泊松观测，无需方差稳定变换，并可选择性保持总强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学数据去噪需兼顾信号相关噪声建模、不同数据维度支持以及定量强度信息保持，现有方法难以统一满足这些需求。

Method: 在BM3D/BM4D两阶段结构基础上，结合噪声感知的块匹配，并将信号相关噪声方差传播通过协同滤波与聚合过程；采用维度无关的参考块遍历方案支持任意轴数数组；引入可选的聚合感知质量守恒，在加权重叠相加后保持观测总强度。

Result: 在一维生理信号、二维图像和三维体数据上，通过受控噪声实验与实测荧光显微数据验证：噪声感知匹配与维纳滤波提升重建质量；低计数模体实验中质量守恒减少去噪导致的强度损失。

Conclusion: BMND提供了一种统一的、非学习的任意维度去噪方法，并已作为开源库发布。

Abstract: Poisson denoising of scientific data requires methods that account for signal-dependent noise while accommodating different data dimensionalities and preserving quantitative intensity information. We present BMND, a dimension-independent extension of block matching and collaborative filtering for Gaussian and Poisson observations. Building on the two-stage structure of BM3D and BM4D, BMND processes Poisson data directly, without a variance-stabilizing transform, by combining noise-aware patch matching with propagation of signal-dependent noise variances through collaborative filtering and aggregation. A dimension-independent reference-patch traversal scheme supports arrays with an arbitrary number of axes. An optional aggregation-aware mass conservation preserves the observed total intensity after weighted overlap-add. We evaluate the framework on one-dimensional physiological signals, two-dimensional images, and three-dimensional volumes, using controlled noise experiments and measured fluorescence microscopy acquisitions. The experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality from noise-aware matching and Wiener filtering, while low-count phantom experiments show reduced denoising-induced intensity loss through mass conservation. The framework provides a unified, non-learning-based approach to denoising across arbitrary data dimensions and is released as an open-source library.

</details>


### [339] [Long Time No See: Benchmarking VLMs for Out-of-Sight Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34630)
*Fangzhou Ma,Ivo Alexander Ban,Eren Homburg,Gabriele Goletto,Rémi Pautrat,Mahdi Rad,Chiara Plizzari,Marc Pollefeys*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出Beyond3D——首个针对"视线外时空推理"(out-of-sight spatiotemporal reasoning)的动态第一人称VQA基准，包含9,000个问题、8种类型，覆盖135个视频；评测九个VLM，最佳模型仅42.2%（随机29.7%，纯文本31.9%），表明该能力远未解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实AI系统（如AR助手、家用机器人）需要推理已离开视野的物体：不仅要回忆其最后可见位置，还要在其被移动后更新状态，并在物体离开视野后保留该更新。现有基准未隔离这一能力。

Method: 基于HD-EPIC标注构建Beyond3D：利用每个动态物体的3D位置、相机位姿与场景几何，建立逐时刻的可见性轨迹，判断物体处于可见、遮挡还是视野外。设计一条推理链的四类能力——视觉定位（目标当前是否可观测）、时间定位（最后可见与最后放置时间）、场景定位（锚定该位置的固定家具）、3D空间感知（相对当前视点或场景中另一物体的位置）；共8种问题类型、9,000题。

Result: 评测九个通用及空间专用VLM。最佳模型准确率42.2%，随机基线29.7%，纯文本基线31.9%；最大失败集中在"恢复物体最后可见时间"上。

Conclusion: 跟踪物体离开视野后的运动对当前VLM仍是未解难题，Beyond3D为隔离并衡量该能力提供了首个专门基准。

Abstract: Real-world AI systems must reason about objects that are no longer visible: an AR assistant guiding a user back to an object used earlier, a household robot retrieving an item someone put away. This requires not just recalling where an object was last seen, but updating its state when it is moved and retaining that update once it leaves view. We refer to this as out-of-sight spatiotemporal reasoning. We introduce Beyond3D, the first VQA benchmark to isolate this ability in dynamic egocentric video: every query targets an object that has been relocated and has since left the field of view. We create our questions from HD-EPIC annotations, building a visibility track for each dynamic object from its 3D position, the camera pose, and the scene geometry to understand at each moment whether it is visible, occluded, or out of view. Beyond3D comprises 9,000 questions in eight types over 135 videos from nine participants, organized as one reasoning chain: visual grounding (is the target observable now), temporal grounding (when it was last visible and last placed), scene localization (which fixture anchors that location), and 3D spatial perception (where it lies relative to the current viewpoint or another object in the scene). We benchmark nine general-purpose and spatially specialized VLMs. The best model reaches 42.2% against 29.7% chance and text-only baselines reaching 31.9%, with the largest failures in recovering when an object was last visible, showing that tracking object movement out of sight remains far from solved for current VLMs.

</details>


### [340] [Backdoor as Probe: Test-Time Adversarial Defense for CLIP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34641)
*Zhongqi Wang,Jie Zhang,Nie Sen,Zhiyu Chen,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BaP将后门触发-目标机制改造为探针，用于CLIP的测试时对抗防御，将对抗激活偏移视为信号而非噪声，在16个基准上将平均鲁棒准确率从1.0%提升至52.3%，且推理速度最多提升5.7倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时对抗防御将对抗激活偏移视为需抑制的失真，未加以利用；同时CLIP等视觉-语言基础模型的鲁棒性提升需兼顾效率与干净精度。

Method: 提出Backdoor as Probe (BaP)：植入防御者控制的后门作为探针，对干净输入弱激活、对对抗偏移强激活；通过对选定MLP层进行闭式模型编辑构造探针，将平均对抗激活偏移与防御者指定语义方向分别投影到该层低能量输入、输出激活子空间，得到触发方向与目标方向；推理时依据目标方向响应检测对抗输入，并通过优化小扰动将其表示推离对抗偏移、拉向干净子空间以实现选择性矫正。

Result: 在16个基准上，BaP将平均鲁棒准确率从1.0%提升至52.3%，同时保持干净准确率，性能与最先进方法相当，并实现最高5.7倍推理加速；对大型视觉-语言模型上的对抗攻击也表现出泛化能力。

Conclusion: 将后门机制反向用作对抗偏移探针是一种有效的测试时防御范式，可在不重训练的前提下兼顾鲁棒性、干净精度与推理效率。

Abstract: Test-time adversarial defense improves the robustness of vision-language foundation models such as CLIP without retraining. However, adversarial activation shifts are typically treated as distortions to suppress, rather than signals to exploit. We turn these shifts into defense signals by repurposing the trigger-to-target mechanism of backdoors. The key is to implant a defender-controlled backdoor as a probe that is weakly activated by clean inputs but strongly activated by adversarial shifts. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Backdoor as Probe} (BaP), a test-time adversarial defense for CLIP. BaP constructs the probe through a closed-form model edit to a selected MLP layer. It projects the average adversarial activation shift and a defender-specified semantic direction onto the layer's low-energy input and output activation subspaces to obtain the trigger and target directions, respectively. At inference time, adversarial inputs produce measurable responses along the target direction for detection. BaP then selectively rectifies detected inputs by optimizing a small perturbation that steers their representations away from adversarial shifts and toward the clean subspace. Experiments across 16 benchmarks show that BaP improves average robust accuracy from 1.0\% to 52.3\% while retaining clean accuracy, achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods with up to a \(5.7\times\) inference speedup. BaP further shows the generalization to adversarial attacks on large vision-language models. Project page: https://robin-wzq.github.io/Backdoor-as-Probe/

</details>


### [341] [DirectUV: Image-Conditioned UV Texture Generation with Surface-Aware Positional Encoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34651)
*Jiantao Lin,Yingjie Xu,Mingzhi Sheng,Yangkai Wei,Hao Chen,Ying-Cong Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DirectUV：在预训练图像 VAE 的 UV 潜空间中做扩散生成纹理的框架，用 Surface-Aware Positional Encoding（SAPE）把注意力从 UV 网格位置解耦到 3D 表面几何，提升接缝与断开 UV 岛之间的纹理连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为 3D 网格生成高质量 UV 纹理仍具挑战：多视图投影流程受遮挡与视角不一致影响；直接在 UV 空间生成的方法依赖辅助模块提供 3D 信息，导致注意力仍绑定在 UV 网格位置而非底层表面几何，从而破坏跨接缝与跨断开 UV 岛的连贯性。

Method: DirectUV 是图像条件化的 UV 纹理扩散框架，在预训练图像 VAE 的潜在 UV 空间中运行，由 Diffusion Transformer 在给定单张输入图像与粗略 UV 图的条件下对 UV 潜变量去噪。核心是 SAPE：用通过 UV-to-surface 对应得到的逐 token 3D 表面坐标导出位置编码，替代标准 2D 网格位置编码；由于位置编码决定注意力的距离度量，SAPE 使 token 依据 3D 表面邻近性而非 UV 网格距离交互。此外提出多层级扩展，将同一 UV 潜块逐级细分分配给不同注意力头，实现多粒度表面结构推理。

Result: 实验表明 DirectUV 生成的纹理比基线更锐利且全局更一致，在遮挡与不可见视角区域提升最大——这些区域中投影类方法会出现纹理缺失或拉伸。

Conclusion: 通过将位置编码建立在 UV 到 3D 表面的一一对应之上，DirectUV 将注意力机制与表面几何对齐，从而在接缝和不相连 UV 岛之间恢复连贯性，并显著改善遮挡与未见视角下的纹理生成质量。

Abstract: Generating high-quality UV textures for 3D meshes remains challenging. Multi-view projection pipelines suffer from occlusion and view inconsistency, and recent methods that generate textures directly in UV space still rely on auxiliary modules to supply 3D information, leaving the attention mechanism tied to UV-grid positions rather than to the underlying surface geometry. This mismatch limits coherence across seams and disconnected UV islands.
  We propose DirectUV, an image-conditioned UV texture diffusion framework that operates in the latent UV space of a pretrained image VAE, in which a Diffusion Transformer denoises the UV latent given a single input image and a coarse UV map. At its core, Surface-Aware Positional Encoding (SAPE) replaces the standard 2D-grid positional encoding with encodings derived from per-token 3D surface coordinates obtained via UV-to-surface correspondence. As positional encodings define the distance metric used by attention, SAPE enables tokens to interact according to 3D positional proximity derived from surface correspondence rather than UV-grid distance, restoring coherence across seams and disconnected islands. A multi-level extension further assigns different attention heads to progressively finer subdivisions of the same latent UV patch, allowing the model to reason about surface structure at multiple granularities.
  Experiments show that DirectUV produces sharper and more globally consistent textures than other baselines, with the largest improvements in occluded and view-unseen regions where projection-based methods leave gaps or stretched textures.

</details>


### [342] [Revitalizing Medical Time Series with Vision-Informed Retrieval: A Vision-Language Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34652)
*Guoqi Yu,Juncheng Wang,Shujun Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Vision-Informed Retrieval (ViRe)，利用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）从波形图中提取形态感知的 Vision Query，引导对原始数值医学时间序列（MedTS）特征进行跨模态检索，从而弥补现有方法仅将 MedTS 表示为数值序列、忽视波形形态信息的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MedTS 分类方法通常仅将其表示为数值序列，未能充分利用临床波形检查中显式的形态（morphology）信息，存在表征利用不足的问题。

Method: ViRe 采用预训练 VLM 从波形图中提取形态感知先验，形成 Vision Query；并设计基于注意力的跨模态检索机制，以该 Vision Query 从数值表示中筛选与形态相关的时间与通道证据。

Result: 在六个公开基准上，ViRe 相较十个既有基线方法表现更优，相对此前最优方法平均提升 6.42%（overall relative improvement）。

Conclusion: ViRe 通过引入视觉形态先验引导数值特征检索，有效提升 MedTS 分类性能，代码与复现材料已开源。

Abstract: Medical time series (MedTS) underpin many clinical classification tasks, yet existing methods usually represent them only as numerical sequences and underuse the morphology that is explicit in waveform inspection. To bridge this gap, we introduce Vision-Informed Retrieval (ViRe), which uses a frozen VLM-derived waveform representation as a morphology-aware Query to guide retrieval from raw numerical MedTS features. Specifically, a Vision Query is extracted using pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) to obtain morphology-aware priors from waveform plots. A tailored attention-based cross-modal retrieval mechanism then uses the Vision Query to select morphology-relevant temporal and channel evidence from the numerical representation. ViRe demonstrates strong effectiveness against ten established baselines, yielding an overall 6.42% relative improvement over the previous state of the art across six public benchmarks. Code, training scripts, and reproducibility materials are publicly available in the GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Levi-Ackman/ViRe.

</details>


### [343] [CapField-OPD: Learning Continuous Capability Fields via Joint-Anchored Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Flow Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34658)
*Pengyang Ling,Yujie Zhou,Jiazi Bu,Yibin Wang,Xiaoxiao Ma,Yi Jin,Huaian Chen,Yuhang Zang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CapField-OPD 提出用显式能力坐标构建连续能力场，将多个奖励专精教师整合到单一学生模型中，实现不依赖提示语义的连续能力控制，并支持基于坐标的测试时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于多教师在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的方法按提示语义类别将每个提示路由到单一教师，隐式地把期望能力绑定到提示内容上。这种耦合导致能力调用对提示扰动敏感，且用户无法在推理时显式调节期望能力的强度。

Method: 提出 CapField-OPD 框架：以教师模型为锚点、通过显式能力坐标构建连续能力场，坐标决定教师输出的组合方式，使每个能力配置获得唯一监督目标；并在小规模校准集上对学到的场进行剖析，以平均奖励最高的坐标作为推荐默认值，频繁最优的坐标构成测试时扩展的候选集。

Result: 在组合生成、文本渲染和视觉美学任务上的大量实验表明：CapField-OPD 将多个专精教师整合为单一学生，同时保持或超越其性能；在语义保持的提示变体下能可靠调用期望能力；并支持连续能力控制和基于坐标的测试时扩展。

Conclusion: 通过将能力与提示语义解耦，CapField-OPD 实现了可控、鲁棒的能力整合与调用，为多教师蒸馏与测试时扩展提供了新范式。

Abstract: Reward-specialized post-training produces strong experts for flow-based generative models, while multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates their capabilities into a single student. Existing methods, however, route each prompt to a single teacher according to its semantic category, implicitly binding the desired capability to prompt content. This coupling makes capability invocation vulnerable to prompt perturbations and prevents users from explicitly adjusting the strength of the desired capability at inference time. In this work, we introduce CapField-OPD, an OPD framework that integrates multiple teachers into a continuous capability field through explicit capability coordinates. We use teacher models as anchors to construct this field, with the coordinates determining how their outputs are combined. Each capability configuration thus receives a unique supervision target, and capability control no longer depends on prompt semantics. Since the training anchors may not be optimal at inference time, we further profile the learned field on a small calibration set. The coordinate with the highest mean reward serves as the recommended default, while coordinates that are frequently optimal offer a promising candidate set for test-time scaling. Extensive experiments on compositional generation, text rendering, and visual aesthetics demonstrate that CapField-OPD consolidates multiple specialized teachers into a single student while preserving or surpassing their performance, reliably invokes the desired capabilities under semantics-preserving prompt variations, and supports continuous capability control and coordinate-based test-time scaling.

</details>


### [344] [Evidence-Aligned Multimodal On-Policy Self-Distillation for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34672)
*Nanxing Hu,Qiwei Yan,Jinchao Zhang,Guoliang Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出证据对齐的多模态在线策略自蒸馏方法EAD，通过构造独立的证据参考来加权教师纠正，仅保留6%的监督量即可超越此前最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度视觉理解要求模型识别复杂图像中的细节。多模态在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）使用以证据为中心的裁剪图像为条件的教师来监督以原图为条件的学生，但两个干扰源削弱了效果：滞后或冻结的教师带来与学生之间的模型状态差距；裁剪虽增强任务相关证据却丢失了视觉上下文。这使得教师纠正并非纯粹由视觉证据驱动。

Method: EAD保留裁剪条件教师作为目标，但构建独立的证据参考来加权纠正。为排除滞后模型状态影响，使用当前学生测量预测变化；为避免裁剪引起的上下文改变，在原图中掩蔽证据区域同时保留其他视觉上下文。学生掩蔽图像预测到原图预测的变化提供了受控参考，指示视觉证据使预测偏移的方向。EAD以每个教师纠正与该参考的余弦对齐度进行加权，保留对齐的纠正并降低其余部分的权重。

Result: EAD在仅保留密集OPSD监督量6%的情况下，持续优于此前的最优方法。

Conclusion: 通过解耦证据参考与教师目标，EAD有效剔除模型状态差距和上下文变化两类干扰，使教师纠正更纯粹地由任务相关视觉证据驱动，以极少的监督量实现了领先性能。

Abstract: Fine-grained visual understanding requires models to recognize small details within complex images. Multimodal on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) addresses this challenge by using a teacher conditioned on evidence-centered crops to supervise a student conditioned on original images along student-generated trajectories. Ideally, teacher corrections, the distributional changes from the student toward the privileged teacher, should be driven by task-relevant visual evidence. However, the designs that make the teacher effective also introduce other interference. Using a lagged or frozen teacher improves training stability but introduces a model-state gap from the evolving student, while cropping enhances task-relevant evidence but also loses the visual context. These two sources of interference make the teacher corrections not purely rely on the visual evidence. We introduce Evidence-Aligned multimodal on-policy self-Distillation (EAD), which retains the crop-conditioned teacher as the target but constructs a separate evidence reference for weighting the corrections. To exclude the effect of lagged model-state from this reference, EAD measures prediction changes using the current student. To avoid crop-induced context changes, EAD masks the evidence region in the original image while preserving the other visual context. The change from the student's masked-image prediction to its original-image prediction provides a controlled reference for the direction in which the visual evidence shifts the student's prediction. EAD weights each teacher correction by its cosine alignment with the reference, i.e., retaining aligned corrections and downweighting the rest. Retaining only 6\% of the supervision mass of dense OPSD, EAD consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [345] [V-Gym: Enhancing Agentic Visual Reasoning via Skill-Data Co-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34682)
*Bei Yan,Yuecong Min,Jie Zhang,Junqi Yang,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 V-Gym 框架，通过执行轨迹中程序性技能与多模态练习数据的迭代共同演化，实现智能体的自主诊断、针对性练习与持续自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态理解、推理与工具使用能力的进步使智能体能处理日益复杂的视觉推理任务。将过往执行经验蒸馏为可复用技能可减少重复错误并提升能力，但有限经验会产生不可靠、泛化性差的技能，而静态数据集缺乏针对性、多样化的练习用于技能精炼，二者之间存在空白。

Method: V-Gym 是一个从执行轨迹中迭代共演化程序性技能与多模态练习数据的自主框架。技能演化阶段：分析轨迹以蒸馏和精炼分层技能，更新程序性指引与适用条件，仅当验证性能提升时才保留更新。数据演化阶段：兼顾数据效用与探索来选择生成种子，将轨迹中识别出的瓶颈转化为多样化、针对性的练习数据，经质量检查后扩充数据银行。练习结果回馈至后续技能更新，形成持续精炼的闭环。

Result: 在多种多模态推理基准上，使用多个骨干模型均相对基线取得显著提升。演化出的技能可跨领域、跨模型泛化；演化出的数据能更有效地支持技能精炼。

Conclusion: V-Gym 通过技能与数据的协同演化闭环，实现了智能体的自主诊断、针对性练习与持续自我改进，验证了技能—数据共演化范式的有效性与泛化能力。

Abstract: Advances in multimodal understanding, reasoning, and tool use enable agents to tackle increasingly complex visual reasoning tasks. By distilling past execution experience into reusable skills, agents can transfer lessons from both successes and failures into future reasoning, reducing repeated errors and improving capabilities. However, limited experience may produce unreliable, poorly generalizable skills, while static datasets may lack the targeted and diverse practice needed for refinement. To address this gap, we introduce V-Gym, an autonomous framework that iteratively co-evolves procedural skills and multimodal practice data from execution trajectories. During skill evolution, V-Gym analyzes trajectories to distill and refine hierarchical skills, updating procedural guidance and applicability conditions while retaining an update only if it improves validation performance. During data evolution, V-Gym selects generation seeds by balancing data utility and exploration, then translates trajectory-identified bottlenecks into diverse, targeted practice data that expand the data bank after quality checks. The resulting practice outcomes feed back into subsequent skill updates, closing the loop for continual skill refinement. Experiments across diverse multimodal reasoning benchmarks show substantial improvements over baselines with multiple backbone models. Its evolved skills generalize across domains and models, while evolved data support more effective skill refinement, enabling autonomous diagnosis, targeted practice, and continual self-improvement.

</details>


### [346] [Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization: Diverse T2I Generation and VLA Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34688)
*Zhiyuan Ma,Jiaming Li,Lingzhen Li,Yu Liu,Xuekai Zhu,Dingkang Liang,Kaiyan Zhang,Jianjun Li,Bowen Zhou,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Uni-TMPO 将奖励最大化式 RL 改为轨迹分布匹配，用前向 KL 优化扩散/流策略，缓解模式坍缩，在 T2I 与 VLA 上同时提升奖励、多样性与泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励最大化式强化学习被广泛用于文本到图像（T2I）扩散与流策略的后训练，但即便加入参考 KL 或熵正则，仍会导致策略模式坍缩，使策略退化为单一高奖励模式。在 T2I 中表现为图像同质化与奖励劫持；扩展到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时，则会消除其他可行策略，削弱任务与场景泛化能力。

Method: 提出统一轨迹匹配策略优化（Uni-TMPO），一个面向扩散与流策略的统一 RL 后训练框架。首先在每个轨迹组内将标准化奖励转换为目标分布，并由轨迹对数概率导出策略分布；随后用前向 KL 优化匹配这两个分布，而非最大化期望奖励。T2I 轨迹通过进度条件化的由粗到细调度器高效构建；VLA 轨迹则在同一框架内通过反馈条件化采样、利用更新后的观测构建。

Result: 大量实验表明，Uni-TMPO 在 T2I 奖励和 VLA 分布内（ID）成功率上均优于最强基线；在 T2I 上取得最优的奖励-多样性-效率权衡，在 VLA 上实现对留出任务与场景的最佳泛化；真机评估还展示了当较高奖励目标受阻时多种动作策略的价值。

Conclusion: 以分布匹配（前向 KL）替代奖励最大化，可在统一框架下有效缓解扩散与流策略的模式坍缩，兼顾奖励、多样性与泛化，并提升真实场景下的策略鲁棒性。

Abstract: Reward-maximizing reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to post-train stochastic diffusion and flow policies for text-to-image (T2I) generation. However, reward-maximizing RL causes policy mode collapse even under reference KL or entropy regularization, reducing the policy to a single high-reward mode. In T2I, this produces similar images and reward hacking. When extended to vision-language-action (VLA) models, the same collapse removes alternative successful strategies and weakens task and scene generalization. To address this limitation, we introduce Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (Uni-TMPO), a unified RL post-training framework for diffusion and flow policies. First, Uni-TMPO converts standardized rewards into a target distribution within each trajectory group and derives the policy distribution from trajectory log probabilities. Then, forward Kullback-Leibler optimization matches the two distributions instead of maximizing expected reward. A progress-conditioned coarse-to-fine scheduler efficiently constructs T2I trajectories. Within the unified framework, feedback-conditioned sampling uses updated observations to construct VLA trajectories. Extensive experiments show that Uni-TMPO achieves higher T2I rewards and VLA ID success rates than the strongest baselines. More importantly, it achieves the best T2I reward-diversity-efficiency trade-off and VLA generalization to held-out tasks and scenes, while real-robot evaluation demonstrates the value of multiple action strategies when the higher-reward target is blocked.

</details>


### [347] [Triangular Resampling for Long-Horizon Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34697)
*Kunhang Li,Yiyi Cai,Xiangyue Zhang,Fangyuan Tu,Yuhan Wu,Zhixiang Wang,Kaipeng Zhang,Haiyang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Triangular Resampling (TR)，一种针对运动扩散模型的后训练方法，通过将rollout训练扩展到部分去噪状态并借助真值钳制，缓解长时域误差累积，在120秒运动生成任务上取得领先的FID AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动扩散模型在长时域生成中存在误差累积问题。既有训练窗口源于真值数据，而推理时状态由模型自身生成，两者存在分布错配。仅替换已完成的历史运动，无法解决活动窗口内部分去噪状态的错配，因此需要一种能覆盖这些中间状态的后训练策略。

Method: 基于FloodDiffusion的三角去噪调度，TR将基于rollout的训练扩展到活动窗口内的部分去噪状态。对每个重放样本采样一个去噪阈值，该阈值在所有潜变量位置与重放更新间共享；在不追踪梯度的条件下重放多步三角去噪。每次更新后，低于阈值的状态用噪声匹配的真值替换，达到或高于阈值的状态保留模型预测，所得潜变量窗口进入标准训练更新。该rollout构造同时支持监督训练（TR）与分布匹配（TR-DMD）。

Result: 在HumanML3D测试提示词上的120秒运动生成任务中，TR与TR-DMD分别在其非DMD与DMD对比组内达到最优FID AUC。相较于无重放的匹配后训练，监督式TR将FID AUC降低40.9%，FID退化斜率降低55.3%。

Conclusion: TR通过将rollout训练延伸至部分去噪状态并结合真值钳制，有效缓解了长时域运动扩散模型的误差累积，且可兼容监督与DMD两类训练范式。

Abstract: We introduce Triangular Resampling (TR), a post-training method for mitigating long-horizon error accumulation in motion diffusion models. Built on FloodDiffusion's triangular denoising schedule, TR addresses the mismatch between ground-truth-derived training windows and model-generated inference states. Replacing only completed motion history leaves this mismatch unresolved in partially denoised states within the active window. TR therefore extends rollout-based training to these states, using ground-truth clamping to limit excessive drift. For each replayed sample, TR draws one denoising threshold, shared across latent positions and replay updates, and replays multi-step triangular denoising without gradient tracking. After each update, states below the threshold are replaced with noise-matched ground truth, while those at or above it retain model predictions. The resulting latent window enters the standard training update. This rollout construction supports both supervised training (TR) and distribution matching (TR-DMD). On 120-second motion generation from HumanML3D test prompts, TR and TR-DMD achieve state-of-the-art FID AUC within their respective non-DMD and DMD comparison groups. Supervised TR reduces FID AUC by 40.9% and FID degradation slope by 55.3% relative to matched post-training without replay.

</details>


### [348] [From Pixel Generation to Topological Inference: Structural Dual Super-Resolution for Trustworthy Cross-Physical-Domain Trabecular Morphology Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34716)
*Fan Zhang,Yi Zhang,Ling Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出从"像素生成"转向"拓扑推断"的新范式，通过结构对偶超分辨网络（SDN）从临床UHRCT低分辨输入确定性推断微观骨小梁结构，实现与SRμCT一致的形态学量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床CT与UHRCT无法分辨单根骨小梁，而SRμCT虽提供3.2μm高分辨参考却无法用于在体成像，二者分辨率相差31.25倍且数据量差异巨大；同时临床UHRCT存在严重部分容积效应、强噪声和束硬化/散射伪影，现有超分网络与预训练先验方法因面向像素生成（追求细节多样性与SSIM/PSNR）而未显式建模这些物理差异，导致32倍超分本质上不适定。

Method: 范式转变：由像素生成转为拓扑推断，即从宏观低分辨输入确定性预测不变微观结构，以形态学参数评估。具体实现为结构对偶超分辨（structural dual super-resolution），通过结构对偶约束将前向物理退化（微观→宏观）与逆向结构推断（宏观→微观）耦合。构建端到端、少样本、紧凑的结构对偶网络（SDN），包含双向建模网络（前向退化与逆向重建）、金字塔结构一致性判别器及四项结构对偶约束。

Result: 在测试集上，SDN在7项形态学指标上与SRμCT基本一致，使临床UHRCT具备显微成像级形态学量化能力，SSIM达0.8。基于3.2μm SSRF数据训练后，模型可良好泛化至独立来源的3.25μm BSRF数据，验证了跨源泛化能力。

Conclusion: 实验证实所设计网络实现的是可信的结构推断而非像素生成，为临床UHRCT提供显微级骨小梁形态学量化开辟新途径，并具备跨数据源泛化潜力。

Abstract: Clinical CT and UHRCT cannot resolve individual trabeculae, whereas synchrotron radiation microCT (SRμCT) provides 3.2μm high-resolution references but is not applicable for in vivo imaging. The two domains differ by 31.25x in resolution, are only coarsely paired, and have drastically different data volumes. Moreover, clinical UHRCT suffers from severe partial volume effects, strong noise, and beam hardening/scatter artifacts, while SRμCT is nearly free. Existing super-resolution networks and pretrained-prior methods underperform because they target pixel generation--diverse details and SSIM/PSNR--and do not explicitly model these physical differences. This indicates that 32x super-resolution via pixel generation is intrinsically ill-posed. We propose a paradigm shift from pixel generation to topological inference: deterministically predicting invariant microstructures from macro-scale low-resolution inputs, evaluated by morphological parameters. We realize this paradigm via structural dual super-resolution, coupling forward physical degradation (micro-to-macro) with inverse structural inference (macro-to-micro) through structural duality constraints. The method is an end-to-end, few-shot, compact structural dual network (SDN), comprising a bidirectional modeling network for forward degradation and inverse reconstruction, a pyramid structural consistency discriminator, and four structural duality constraints. On the testset, SDN achieves morphological parameters largely consistent with SRμCT across 7 metrics, enabling clinical UHRCT with micro-imaging-level morphological quantification, with SSIM reaching 0.8. Trained on 3.2μm SSRF data, the model generalizes well to 3.25μm BSRF data from an independent source, validating cross-source generalization and confirming that the designed network achieves trustworthy structural inference rather than pixel generation.

</details>


### [349] [DBCF: Dual-Branch Complementary Fusion of Foundation Models for Generalized Deepfake Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34720)
*Fengming Gu,Mingjie He,Zonghui Guo,Jie Zhangb,Shiguang Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出分层多粒度框架，融合CLIP全局语义与DINOv3局部结构特征，用于人脸伪造检测，提升跨域与跨操纵泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像生成与编辑技术发展使人脸伪造威胁隐私与公共安全。现有小规模检测模型难以捕获伪造线索，跨域、跨未知操纵泛化能力差；单一基础模型亦不足：CLIP全局语义强但局部细节弱，DINO局部结构强但全局语义弱。

Method: 提出分层多粒度框架，集成互补预训练表示：全局上下文分支（GCB）基于CLIP捕获整体语义线索；细粒度线索分支（FCB）基于DINOv3捕获局部结构异常；设计特征融合模块，通过自适应提取与整合两模型互补特征，实现冻结基础骨干的参数高效适配。

Result: 在多个基准上实验表明，联合全局上下文与细粒度线索可学习更全面的伪造表示，在跨数据集与跨操纵设置下取得强性能，验证了设计有效性。

Conclusion: 融合多基础模型的互补表示能有效提升人脸伪造检测的泛化能力，尤其适用于跨数据集和跨操纵场景。

Abstract: As image generation and editing technologies have progressed substantially, facial forgeries pose significant challenges to privacy and public safety. Due to limited ability to capture forgery cues, existing small-scale forgery detection models often struggle to generalize across various domains and unseen manipulations. To address this limitation, researchers have turned to large-scale foundation models, which can provide richer representations and better generalization. Nevertheless, relying on a single foundation model alone remains insufficient for effective forgery detection. While models like CLIP offer robust global semantic cues, they lack the capacity to capture detailed local facial features. In contrast, DINO excels at capturing local structural features of faces, but provides weaker global semantic context. To fully utilize the synergies among multiple foundation models, we propose a hierarchical multi-granular framework that integrates complementary pretrained representations. Specifically, a Global Context Branch (GCB) based on CLIP captures holistic semantic cues, while a Fine-grained Cue Branch (FCB) built on DINOv3 captures localized structural irregularities. In addition, we design a feature fusion module that enables parameter-efficient adaptation of the frozen foundation backbones by adaptively extracting and integrating complementary features from the two models. By jointly leveraging global context and fine-grained cues, our method learns more comprehensive forgery representations and achieves strong cross-manipulation performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the benefit of the proposed design, particularly under cross-dataset and cross-manipulation settings.

</details>


### [350] [Geometry as Address: Routing Attention to Visual Memory for Long-Horizon Camera-Controlled Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34722)
*Zesong Yang,Weikai Chen,Liyuan Cui,Lutao Jiang,Runze Zhang,Yingda Yin,Xiaoyang Huang,Kai Yan,Keyang Luo,Wangguandong Zheng,Xin Wang,Hujun Bao,Zhaopeng Cui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GEAR框架，将几何用作视觉记忆的token级寻址信号而非全局3D重建，通过几何对应注意力与不可见八叉树实现长时相机控制视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时域相机控制视频生成需从不断增长的视觉历史中恢复已观测内容。现有方法要么隐式检索历史上下文，要么将其重建为持久3D记忆，分别面临记忆访问效率低或几何误差累积的问题。

Method: 核心洞见：几何无需解释场景，只需决定从何处读取视觉记忆，由注意力决定恢复内容。据此提出GEAR：以几何作为显式token级记忆地址，保留历史观测为帧潜变量（frame latents），仅用逐帧几何建立与目标视角的token级对应，避免全局融合带来的持续性误差累积。基于对应关系，几何对应注意力（GCA）在去噪过程中将几何匹配的历史特征选择性注入噪声目标patch；并引入Invisible Octree累积可见性证据，剔除几何合理但被遮挡的对应。

Result: 大量实验表明GEAR在视觉质量、相机控制精度和重访一致性上达到当前最优，可在挑战性轨迹下生成分钟级长视频。

Conclusion: 将几何从场景表示降级为记忆寻址机制，可有效规避全局3D融合的误差累积与隐式检索的低效，为长时域相机控制视频生成提供了新范式。

Abstract: Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation requires recovering previously observed content from an ever-growing visual history. Existing approaches either search historical context implicitly or reconstruct it into persistent 3D memory, facing inefficient memory access or accumulated geometric errors. Our key insight is that geometry need not explain the scene--it only needs to determine where visual memory should be read from, while attention decides what should be recovered. Based on this insight, we introduce GEAR, a Geometry-Enabled Attention Routing framework that uses geometry as an explicit token-level address for visual memory. Rather than fusing historical observations into a persistent global 3D representation, GEAR retains them as frame latents and uses per-frame geometry only to establish token-level correspondences with target views, thereby avoiding persistent error accumulation from global fusion. Guided by these correspondences, Geometric Correspondence Attention (GCA) selectively injects geometrically matched historical features into noisy target patches during denoising. We further introduce an Invisible Octree to accumulate visibility evidence and reject geometrically plausible but occluded correspondences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GEAR achieves state-of-the-art visual quality, precise camera control, and revisit consistency, enabling minute-long video generation along challenging trajectories.

</details>


### [351] [What Visual Generators Need from Teachers: Rethinking Representation Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34732)
*Yongcong Wang,Hingchin Chen,Mingyu Fan,Shuo Jiang,Teer Zhang,Yucong Sun,Zijia Wang,Yiming Lu,Chengchao Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出RARE方法，通过衡量教师层级增量在未对齐学生模型中的“不可恢复比例”（recoverability gap），在训练前自动选择最优对齐层，并在训练中依据每token到目标层的剩余距离加权并适时退场对齐损失，从而超越REPA等基线并节省14% GPU时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表征对齐（将学生模型中间层拉向冻结教师编码器特征）能加速扩散Transformer训练，但“对齐教师哪一层、对齐多久”通常凭惯例设定，每种选择都需付出一次完整训练开销，缺乏预训练前的可判定依据。

Method: 作者观察到对齐起作用的位置是学生无法线性恢复教师特征之处，而非已相似之处。基于深层可由其下层大部分预测，他们分离出每层“增量”，测量未对齐学生对其的恢复程度，定义“recoverability gap”（增量中未恢复的比例），并从单个未对齐checkpoint读取。RARE用该gap在训练前选定教师层；训练中跟踪每个token到该层的剩余距离（gap的在线对应量），据此加权token，并在平均距离不再下降后退场对齐损失。

Result: 短程实验中，gap几乎复现各层按FID提升的排名，而CKA（特征相似度）基本给出相反排序。SiT-B/2在ImageNet 256×256上，RARE无引导FID为18.02、有引导为4.46，优于包括REPA、iREPA、HASTE在内的七个对齐基线，且比iREPA少用14% GPU时间；在不同模型规模、教师、数据集和骨干上FID均低于iREPA。

Conclusion: 层级对齐的有效性取决于学生对该层增量的不可恢复程度，而非特征相似度；以recoverability gap为准则的RARE实现了免试错式的对齐层选择与自适应损失退场，在效率与生成质量上均优于现有对齐方法，并具备良好泛化性。

Abstract: Representation alignment speeds up diffusion transformer training by pulling an intermediate block of the model (student) toward features of a frozen pretrained encoder (teacher). Which teacher layer to align, and for how long, is still set by convention, and each alternative costs a training run. We find that alignment helps where the student cannot linearly recover the teacher's features, not where it already resembles them. Since a deep teacher layer is largely predictable from the one below, we isolate what each layer adds, its increment, and measure how much of it an unaligned student recovers. The student fills the teacher's hierarchy from the bottom up and stalls near the top, which we call hierarchy filling: even after 400K steps it recovers almost none of the deepest.
